custom.en: to become bored with something, or to become tired
custom.zh: 厌倦（tire of）；（使）疲劳、变累；轮胎（美式拼写，英式作 tyre）
forms: adj. 累的；厌倦的（be tired of）
examples: 长时间的会议让我筋疲力尽。
孩子们玩这个游戏从来不腻。
custom.tip: tire 当动词＝“使累”，tired 就是“被弄累了”；tire of sth＝玩腻、厌倦。当名词是“轮胎”（英式拼 tyre），两个意思同形不同义。

custom.en: the sound of people clapping to show they enjoyed or approve of something
custom.zh: 掌声；鼓掌；喝彩、称赞
examples: Let's give her a round of {applause}!
让我们给她热烈的掌声！
custom.tip: applause 是不可数名词，不说 an applause，要说 a round of applause（一阵掌声）。动词是 applaud，plaud 有“拍手”的意思。

custom.en: not giving enough care or thought to what you do or to other people
custom.zh: 漫不经心的、不顾及他人的；粗心的、马虎的；随意的、不在乎的
forms: adv. 粗心地；漫不经心地
examples: Well, if he's not here, he has a reason because there is not a cruel or {careless} bone in his body.
好吧，如果他没来，那他一定有原因，因为他骨子里一点也不残忍、不马虎。
It was {careless} of me to forget.
一个粗心的司机造成了这场事故。
custom.tip: care（在意）+ -less（没有）＝“不在意” → 粗心、漫不经心。反义词 careful＝care + -ful（充满）。

custom.en: deliberately causing pain or suffering to people or animals
custom.zh: 残忍的；残酷的；无情的
examples: Well, if he's not here, he has a reason because there is not a {cruel} or careless bone in his body.
好吧，如果他没来，那他一定有原因，因为他骨子里一点也不残忍、不马虎。
Don't be so {cruel} to your brother.
custom.tip: cruel 和 crude（粗糙）长得像但不同；animal cruelty＝虐待动物。谐音“哭肉”：残忍到让人哭。

custom.en: how high or low a sound or voice is
custom.zh: 音高；音调；（体育）场地、球场；投球；推销、宣传说辞；沥青
forms: n. 复数 / v. 第三人称单数
过去式；adj. 有……音高的（high-pitched 尖声的）
examples: melodically, for a yes-no question, and that is his {pitch} goes up towards the end of the phrase.
从旋律上看，是非疑问句中，他的音调会在句末上扬。
Her voice has a very high {pitch}.
他的推销说辞讲得很棒。
custom.tip: pitch 核心是“抛、定高低”：把球抛出去＝投球，把声音定在某个高度＝音高，把想法抛给别人＝推销（pitch an idea）。英式英语里 football pitch＝足球场。

custom.en: a long piece of writing on a subject, done for a university degree
custom.zh: （毕业）论文、学位论文；论点、论题
examples: And they say, “We need to talk about your {thesis}.”
他们说：“我们得和你谈谈你的论文。”
What's the main {thesis} of this essay?
这篇文章的中心论点是什么？
custom.tip: 复数不加 s，是 theses（同 crisis→crises）。thesis 多指硕士/本科论文，博士论文常说 dissertation；学术期刊上的文章叫 paper。

custom.en: to lift something out with a curved, spoon-like movement; also a spoon-shaped tool
custom.zh: 舀、挖（向下再向上的弧形动作）；勺子、铲子；一勺的量；独家新闻
forms: n. 复数 / v. 第三人称单数
examples: our way up. Will you be mean to him too? And then too also has that {scoop} down and then back up.
……一路往上。你也会对他刻薄吗？然后 too 这个词的语调也有那种先往下“舀”、再往上扬的走向。
She {scooped} up the baby and ran.
custom.tip: 想象冰淇淋勺：先往下挖，再往上带起 → 这就是 scoop 的动作，所以语调先降后升也能形容为 scoop。记者“挖”到的独家新闻也叫 scoop。

custom.en: past tense of reinvent: changed something or yourself so much that it seems new
custom.zh: 重塑（了）、彻底改造（了）；重新发明（了）
forms: 原形 v. 重塑；重新发明
examples: picking your spots, business decisions. But a guy like Horford has {reinvented}
……挑选出手位置、做商业决策。但像霍福德这样的球员已经重塑了（自己）
The brand {reinvented} its image last year.
这个品牌去年彻底重塑了形象。
custom.tip: re-（重新）+ invent（发明）。reinvent oneself＝“重塑自我、转型”，体育/职场里最常见；reinvent the wheel＝重复造轮子，白费力气。

custom.en: plural of impact: strong effects that something has on someone or something
custom.zh: 影响（复数）；冲击；撞击
forms: n. 影响；撞击 / v. 影响
examples: those guys have been able to reinvent and have the big {impacts}.
这些人能够重塑自己，并产生巨大的影响。
社交媒体影响着我们的思维方式。
The new law had big {impacts} on small businesses.
新法规对小企业影响很大。
custom.tip: im-（进入）+ pact（压、撞）＝“撞进去” → 冲击 → 影响。固定搭配：have an impact on sth（对……有影响）。

custom.en: the process of getting bigger, better or more developed
custom.zh: 成长；增长；发展；生长；（身体上的）肿块
examples: Yeah, I mean one word I always talk about is like the just {growth} mindset.
是的，我常说的一个词就是“成长型思维”。
The city saw rapid {growth} last year.
这座城市去年发展很快。
旅行对个人成长很有帮助。
custom.tip: grow（长）+ -th（名词后缀，同 true→truth、wide→width）＝生长、增长。growth mindset 成长型思维 vs fixed mindset 固定型思维。

custom.en: a person's way of thinking and their attitudes
custom.zh: 思维方式；心态；观念
examples: Yeah, I mean one word I always talk about is like the just growth {mindset}.
是的，我常说的一个词就是“成长型思维”。
改变思维方式需要时间。
custom.tip: mind（头脑）+ set（设定好的）＝脑子里“设定好的模式” → 思维方式、心态。常说 get into the right mindset（进入状态）。

custom.en: I filled a glass with some wine for myself.
custom.zh: 我给自己倒了点酒。
examples: She {poured herself} a cup of tea.
他给自己做了个三明治。
custom.tip: pour oneself sth＝给自己倒（饮料），句型是“动词 + 反身代词 + 东西”，同类还有 make myself coffee、help yourself（请自便）。pour 读 /pɔr/，和 poor 发音相近。

custom.en: plural of guy: men, or (informally) a group of people of any gender
custom.zh: 大家、伙计们（you guys，口语称呼，男女都可用）；家伙、男人（guy 的复数）
forms: n. 单数 家伙；男人
examples: Those {guys} are really good at basketball.
那几个人篮球打得真好。
custom.tip: 单数 guy 一般指男的，但复数 you guys / hey guys 称呼一群人时男女通用，相当于“大家、你们”，非常口语。

custom.en: the act or process of moving, or a particular movement
custom.zh: 动作、姿势；运动、移动；（会议上的）动议、提案
examples: Use a smooth {motion} when you shoot.
custom.tip: mot- 词根＝“动”：motor（马达）、emotion（情绪是心里的“动”）、motivate（激励）。go through the motions＝走过场、敷衍了事。

custom.en: to look at something with your eyes partly closed
custom.zh: 眯眼（看）；斜视（眼疾）；眯眼的样子
examples: I had to {squint} in the bright sun.
阳光太刺眼，我只好眯着眼。
custom.tip: squint 和 squeeze（挤）开头一样：把眼睛“挤”成一条缝看东西。常用 squint at sth（眯眼看某物）。

custom.en: plural of decision: choices you make after thinking about something
custom.zh: 决定（复数）；决策；果断
examples: So the Rational Decision-Maker will make the rational {decision}
所以理性决策者会做出理性的决定
I make bad {decisions} when I'm tired.
我累的时候容易做错决定。
We need to make some tough {decisions}.
我们得做一些艰难的决定。
custom.tip: 搭配用 make a decision（做决定），不说 do a decision。de-（离开）+ cis（切）＝“切断其他选择” → 决定，同根词 scissors（剪刀）。

custom.en: to change something or yourself so much that it seems completely new
custom.zh: 重塑、彻底改造（reinvent oneself 转型）；重新发明
examples: He wants to {reinvent} himself after college.
他想在大学毕业后重塑自我。
别重复造轮子（别白费力气）。
The company had to {reinvent} itself to survive.
公司必须彻底转型才能活下去。
custom.tip: re-（重新）+ invent（发明）。最常见的两个用法：reinvent oneself（转型、重塑自我）和 reinvent the wheel（重复造轮子，做无用功）。

custom.en: plural of possession: the things that you own
custom.zh: （个人）财物、所有物；财产；（possession）拥有、持有
forms: n. 单数 拥有；所有物
adj. 占有欲强的；所有格的
examples: 比起物质，她更看重经历。
custom.tip: 复数 possessions＝“个人的东西、家当”；单数 possession 多指“拥有”（in possession of）。篮球里 possession 是“球权”。

custom.en: someone who keeps delaying things they should do
custom.zh: 拖延者；爱拖延的人
examples: what goes on in the heads of {procrastinators},
拖延者脑子里在想什么
我是个超级拖延症患者。
每个拖延的人都爱截止日期延期。
custom.tip: pro-（向前）+ crastin（明天，拉丁语 cras）＝“推到明天” → 拖延；-or 表示人。

custom.en: the time or date by which something must be finished
custom.zh: 截止日期；最后期限
examples: 距离截止日期还有三天，
我总是赶不上截止日期。
custom.tip: dead（死）+ line（线）＝“死线”，超过就不行了，中文网络用语“DDL”就是它的缩写。

custom.en: plural of brain; also (informal) intelligence
custom.zh: 大脑（复数）；头脑、智力；（the brains）出主意的人、智囊
examples: that the {brains} of procrastinators were actually different
拖延者的大脑实际上是不同的
他是这个项目的幕后智囊。
custom.tip: brains 复数常表示“聪明才智”：use your brains（动动脑子）；the brains behind sth＝背后出主意的人。

custom.en: one of the hard parts that make up the skeleton of a body
custom.zh: 骨头；（not a … bone in one's body）骨子里毫无……；骨质
forms: adj. 骨瘦如柴的；多刺的
examples: Well, if he's not here, he has a reason because there is not a cruel or careless {bone} in his body.
好吧，如果他没来，那他一定有原因，因为他骨子里一点也不残忍、不马虎。
She doesn't have a mean {bone} in her body.
He broke a {bone} in his foot.
custom.tip: There isn't a mean/lazy bone in his body＝他骨子里一点都不刻薄/懒，夸人常用。另外 have a bone to pick with sb＝要和某人算账。

custom.en: to take place, especially without being planned
custom.zh: 发生；碰巧（happen to do）；（happen to sb）某人遭遇……
examples: And that would {happen} every single paper.
而且每次写论文都会这样。
custom.tip: happen 不用被动语态，不说 was happened。happen to do＝碰巧做；happen to sb＝某人出了事。hap 有“运气”之意，同根 happy、perhaps。

custom.en: achieving a lot or getting useful results
custom.zh: 有成效的、高效的；（土地等）多产的；有意义的
examples: 我们开个有成效的会吧。
custom.tip: produce（生产）→ product（产品）→ productive（能产出的）→ 高效的。日常常说 a productive day（充实高效的一天）。

custom.en: a consonant sound made by letting air out through the nose, like m, n or ng
custom.zh: 鼻辅音（如 m、n、ng）
examples: Man, man, now that has more length. Man is the ae vowel followed by the {nasal consonant} N.
Man，man，这个音就更长了。Man 是 ae 元音，后面跟着鼻辅音 N。
custom.tip: nasal（鼻子的）+ consonant（辅音）。发音时捏住鼻子就发不出 m、n、ng，说明气流走鼻腔。元音在鼻辅音前通常会拉长，比如 man 比 mat 长。

custom.en: a speech sound that is not a vowel, like b, t or s
custom.zh: 辅音；（正式）一致的、和谐的（consonant with）
examples: Man, man, now that has more length. Man is the ae vowel followed by the nasal {consonant} N.
Man，man，这个音就更长了。Man 是 ae 元音，后面跟着鼻辅音 N。
custom.tip: con-（一起）+ son（声音，同 sound、sonic）＝“和元音一起才能发声的音” → 辅音。vowel 是元音，a/e/i/o/u。

custom.en: to arrange for a seat, table or room to be kept for you to use later; also a supply kept for future use
custom.zh: ①预订、保留 ②储备、后备 ③自然保护区 ④reserved=内向/矜持
examples: I'd like to {reserve} a table for two.
I have a {reservation} under the name Ban.
我们留了一些现金储备。
custom.tip: re（再）+ serve（服务）→ 提前“保留服务”→ 预订；引申出“储备、保留地”

custom.en: a thick liquid served with or on food to add flavour
custom.zh: 酱汁（浇/拌在食物上）
examples: Can I have extra {sauce} on my noodles?
我的面可以多加点酱吗？
custom.tip: sauce 是“酱浇过来” → 浇/拌在食物上

custom.en: to put something quickly into a liquid and take it out; also a thick sauce you dip food into
custom.zh: ①蘸（动词）②一碟蘸酱（名词）③下降、下跌 ④泡一下、游一下（take a dip）
examples: Let's take a {dip} in the sea.
custom.tip: dip 本意“向下浸” → 蘸；引申为“向下” → 下降、下跌、泡水

custom.en: to store something safely in a hidden place
custom.zh: 把东西藏好、收起来；一批私藏
examples: I {stashed} my passport in the hotel safe.
我把护照收进酒店保险箱了。
Keep a small {stash} of cash for tuk-tuks.
custom.tip: stash 和 cash 押韵 → “Stash your cash!” 把现金藏好！比 hide 多了“留着以后用”的意思

custom.en: tasting, smelling or coloured like charcoal (informal)
custom.zh: 有炭味的；炭灰色的（口语）
examples: The grilled pork has a nice {charcoaly} flavor.
这烤猪肉有股很香的炭烤味。
I love that {charcoaly} smell of street BBQ.
我超爱街边烧烤那股炭火味。
custom.tip: charcoal(木炭)+ -y → 有炭味/炭色的。-y 后缀万能：salt→salty 咸，oil→oily 油，smoke→smoky 烟熏

custom.en: a substance from a plant used to flavour food; (verb) to add interest or excitement
custom.zh: 香料；辣味；（动词）加香料/增添趣味
examples: Thai food uses a lot of {spices}.
custom.tip: spice + y → spicy 辣的（又是 -y 后缀）。点餐记住：Is it spicy? / Not spicy, please.

custom.en: to make something more interesting, exciting or flavourful
custom.zh: 给…加点料、让…更有意思/刺激
examples: They traveled to {spice up} their relationship.
他们去旅行给感情添点新鲜感。
custom.tip: food 或 life 都能 spice up。习语：Variety is the spice of life. 多样是生活的调味剂

custom.en: a dish of meat or vegetables cooked in a sauce of hot spices, originally from South Asia
custom.zh: 咖喱（用香料煮的菜/酱）
examples: I'll have the green {curry} with chicken.
custom.tip: 泰国咖喱：green（绿,中辣）/ red（红,偏辣）/ yellow（黄,温和）/ massaman（玛莎曼,带花生最不辣）。注意 curry 不是 -y 后缀词

custom.en: to try to make someone like or support you by praising or pleasing them
custom.zh: 讨好、巴结某人
examples: He's always trying to {curry favor with} the boss.
custom.tip: 想象给人“端上一盘咖喱”来讨好 🍛 → curry favor = 拍马屁（跟食物咖喱词源不同，但好记）

custom.en: a sea creature with a hard shell and two large claws; (informal verb) to complain
custom.zh: ①螃蟹（名词）②蟹肉 ③（口语动词）抱怨、发牢骚 ④爱抱怨的人；crabby=暴躁的
examples: He's such {a crab} in the morning.
他一早上脾气都很暴躁。
custom.tip: 一串意思都跟螃蟹有关：横着走、夹人 → 引申“别扭、爱抱怨”。动词 crab=发牢骚(Stop crabbing!)，crabby=暴躁的（双写 b）

custom.en: a style of cooking, especially the food of a particular country or region
custom.zh: 菜系、料理、饭菜（某地/某风格的菜）
examples: Thai {cuisine} is known for its balance of flavors.
泰国菜以味道平衡著称。
I want to try the local {cuisine}.
custom.tip: 来自法语，重音在后 /kwɪˈziːn/。Thai / Italian / French cuisine = 泰/意/法料理

custom.en: a rare or fine food considered especially nice to eat; also delicate quality
custom.zh: ①特色美食、珍馐 ②精致、细腻、微妙
examples: Mango sticky rice is a local {delicacy}.
芒果糯米饭是当地特色美食。
The dish was prepared with great {delicacy}.
custom.tip: delicate(精致)→ delicacy 珍馐/精致。复数 delicacies = 各种美食

custom.en: relating to high-quality food; a person who knows a lot about good food
custom.zh: ①(形容词)精致高档的美食 ②(名词)美食家
examples: 他们去了一家高级餐厅。
custom.tip: 法语来源，t 不发音 /ˈɡʊəmeɪ/。指“高档、讲究”的美食或懂吃的人

custom.en: a person who loves food and knows a lot about it (informal)
custom.zh: 吃货、美食爱好者（口语）
custom.tip: food + -ie（表人、亲昵）→ 爱吃的人。口语超常用，朋友间自称 foodie

custom.en: the particular taste of a food or drink; (verb) to give taste to food
custom.zh: ①味道、风味 ②口味、种类 ③（动词）调味；flavour=英式拼写
custom.tip: 美式 flavor / 英式 flavour。flavor+ful=flavorful 味道足的；strawberry-flavored 草莓味的

custom.en: a large tropical fruit with a hard spiky shell and a strong smell, from Southeast Asia
custom.zh: 榴莲（水果之王）
examples: 榴莲味道很冲但口感很滑。
custom.tip: 读 /ˈdjʊəriən/（DURE-ee-un）三音节重音在前。外号 the king of fruits；很多酒店/交通工具禁带

custom.en: a pleasant series of musical notes; (verb) to adjust an instrument or radio
custom.zh: ①曲调、旋律（名词）②调音、调台（动词）③tuned=调好的
examples: He {tuned} his guitar before the show.
The radio is {tuned} to the news.
custom.tip: tune 跟“音乐/频率”有关：调音、调台。延伸出 stay tuned、tune in、tune out（见短语）

custom.en: used to tell people to keep watching or listening because more is coming
custom.zh: 敬请期待、继续关注（别走开）
custom.tip: 想象收音机别换台 → 继续关注。视频/节目结尾超高频

custom.en: to watch or listen to a programme; (out) to stop paying attention
custom.zh: tune in=收看/收听；tune out=走神、不理会
examples: {Tune in} next week for the finale.
I {tuned out} halfway through the lecture.
讲座听到一半我就走神了。
custom.tip: in=调进这个台 → 收看；out=调出去 → 走神、不听

custom.en: of high quality; very thin or small; (weather) bright; satisfactory; (noun) money paid as a penalty
custom.zh: ①好的、没问题；(身体)还好 ②(语气)行吧、好吧 ③精致的、高级的 ④细的、细小的 ⑤晴朗的 ⑥罚款(名词/动词)
forms: 好的；精致的；细的；晴朗的
精细地（finely chopped 切得很细）
examples: 我们吃了顿很棒的晚餐。
Read the {fine} print before you sign.
custom.tip: 超多义！两个易忽略点：①单说“Fine.”常带不情愿/赌气=“行吧”（影视常见，听语气）②fine=罚款，a parking fine 停车罚单（旅行实用）

custom.en: a large sea creature with a hard shell, two large claws and eight legs, eaten as food
custom.zh: 龙虾
forms: 晒/热得通红（像煮熟的龙虾）
examples: I got sunburned and turned as red as a {lobster}.
我被晒伤，红得像只龙虾。
custom.tip: 读 /ˈlɒbstə(r)/（LOB-ster）。习语 red as a lobster=晒/热得通红，泰国大太阳下很用得上

custom.en: a tropical grass with a lemon flavour used in cooking, especially Southeast Asian dishes
custom.zh: 香茅、香茅草（泰国菜常用香草）
examples: Tom yum is made with {lemongrass} and chili.
冬阴功是用香茅和辣椒做的。
custom.tip: lemon（柠檬）+ grass（草）→ 柠檬味的草 = 香茅。冬阴功 Tom Yum 的灵魂香料

custom.en: a plant whose leaves are used to flavour food or as a medicine
custom.zh: 香草、药草（做菜或草药用的植物）
forms: 草本的（herbal tea 花草茶）
examples: 泰国菜用很多新鲜香草。
custom.tip: 美式 herb 的 h 不发音（读“erb”/ɜːrb/），英式发 h。herbal tea 花草茶

custom.en: to look at someone or something to make sure they are safe, correct or making progress
custom.zh: 查看一下、关照一下；（餐厅）催一下
examples: 能帮我们看下点的菜吗？（催菜）
我去看看孩子们怎么样。
custom.tip: 催菜别说 hurry up（偏凶）。用 check on=帮忙看一下，礼貌又有效

custom.word: Excuse me, could you check on our order?
custom.zh: 不好意思，能帮我们看下点的菜吗？（催菜最常用）
custom.tip: 催菜万能句。想问还要多久：How much longer will our food be?

custom.en: using or relating to computer technology; showing information as numbers
custom.zh: ①数字的、数码的 ②电子显示的（对比 analog 指针式）
custom.tip: digit=手指/数字，古人掰手指数数 → digital 数字的。反义 analog 指针/模拟式

custom.en: a person who works remotely over the internet while travelling from place to place
custom.zh: 数字游民（边远程工作边旅行的人）
examples: He's a {digital nomad} working from Bali.
他是个在巴厘岛远程办公的数字游民。
泰国很受数字游民欢迎。
custom.tip: nomad 游牧者 + digital → 靠网络远程工作、四处旅行的人。泰国清迈是热门据点

custom.en: a travelling show with performers such as acrobats and clowns; (informal) a noisy, chaotic situation
custom.zh: ①马戏团、马戏表演 ②(口语)乱成一团的场面、闹剧 ③(英式地名)圆形广场
examples: We took the kids to the {circus}.
This place is a total {circus} today!
custom.tip: 词根 circ=圆/环（马戏在圆形场地 ring 表演）。比喻义“乱成一团/闹剧”影视常用：a media circus

custom.word: 词根 circ = 圆 / 环
custom.zh: 含 circ 的词大多跟“圆、绕、循环”有关
examples: We ran one {circuit} of the park.
custom.tip: 看到 circ 就想“圆/绕”：circle 圆、circuit 回路、circulate 循环、circus 圆形马戏场

custom.en: a period of time spent doing a particular activity
custom.zh: ①一段(活动)时间、一节、一场 ②(会议)会期、(议会/法庭)开庭
examples: It was a long {session} at work.
custom.tip: 源自“坐(sit)”→ 坐下来做一件事的一段时间 → 一节/一场。study/training/gaming session

custom.en: affecting or relating to all or most people or things; not specialized or detailed
custom.zh: ①一般的、普遍的、总的 ②综合的、不专门的 ③(名词)将军；in general=总的来说
custom.tip: gener=种类 → 适用于一整类 → 一般的/综合的。in general 总的来说；general 也指“将军”（统领全体）

custom.en: to move or mix something violently; (business) the rate at which customers stop using a service
custom.zh: ①搅动、剧烈翻腾(水/胃) ②搅拌奶油做黄油 ③(商业)客户流失/流失率 ④搅乳器(名词)
examples: My stomach was {churning} before the interview.
面试前我紧张得胃里翻腾。
custom.tip: 核心“剧烈搅动”：水翻腾、胃翻江倒海；引申到商业=用户像被搅走 → 客户流失(churn rate)

custom.en: to produce something quickly and in large amounts
custom.zh: 批量产出、大量炮制（常含“量多但未必精”意）
examples: The factory {churns out} thousands of toys a day.
这工厂每天批量生产数千个玩具。
He {churns out} a new article every day.
他每天批量产出一篇新文章。
custom.tip: 像机器不停搅着往外吐 → 大批量产出（语气常带“多而未必精”）

custom.en: the condition someone or something is in at a particular time; a country or its government; (verb) to say formally
custom.zh: ①状态、情形 ②国家、州 ③(动词)陈述、声明 ④be in a state 心烦意乱
custom.tip: sta=站立 → 所处样子=状态；站成一片地=国家/州；动词=陈述。对比 status：state 偏“整体状况”

custom.en: a person's social or professional position; the current condition or stage of something
custom.zh: ①地位、身份 ②(当前/官方)进展状态、情形
custom.tip: status 偏“地位/身份”和“官方当前进展”：marital status 婚姻状况、order status 订单状态、VIP status

custom.word: 词根 sta / stat = 站立、站定
custom.zh: 含 sta/stat 的词大多跟“站、立、稳定”有关
custom.tip: 看到 sta/stat 想“站/立/稳”：stand 站、station 车站、stable 稳定、statue 雕像、state/status 状态地位

custom.en: a pleasant gentle rise and fall in the sound of a voice or a piece of music
custom.zh: ①(说话的)抑扬顿挫、悦耳起伏的腔调 ②轻快的旋律 ③(动词)用轻快调子唱/说
forms: 悦耳起伏的腔调；轻快旋律
轻快悦耳的、抑扬起伏的
examples: She spoke with a soft Irish {lilt}.
她说话带着柔和的爱尔兰腔（抑扬起伏）。
custom.tip: 把 lilt 跟 lift（抬起）联系：声音轻轻“提”起来、一起一伏 → 抑扬悦耳。常形容口音/旋律：an Irish lilt

custom.en: very cruel or violent; (informal) very harsh, difficult or unpleasant
custom.zh: ①残忍的、野蛮的 ②残酷的、无情的(真相/天气) ③(口语)要命的、糟透的、极难的
forms: 残忍地；极其(brutally honest 极坦白)
custom.tip: brutal ← brute 野兽 → 像野兽般残忍；口语里=“要命的、糟透的”：a brutal Monday 糟糕的周一

custom.en: saying exactly what you think in a very direct way, even if it is unpleasant
custom.zh: 极其坦白、直言不讳（坦白到有点扎心）
examples: Can I be {brutally honest} with you?
To be {brutally honest}, I didn't like it.
custom.tip: brutally(残酷地)+ honest(诚实)→ 坦白到扎心。开口先说 To be brutally honest… 我直说了

custom.en: a place to stay, live or work; also the act of adapting to suit someone
custom.zh: ①住宿、住处 ②适应、迁就、通融
examples: We're looking for cheap {accommodation} in Bangkok.
我们在找曼谷便宜的住宿。
工作人员很周到、好商量。
custom.tip: 拼写易错！双 c + 双 m（a-cc-o-mm-odation）。记法：住得下要“双倍空间”→ 字母也双双。重音在 DA：a-ccom-mo-DA-tion

custom.en: very strange or unusual; mysterious and hard to explain
custom.zh: ①奇怪的、古怪的 ②诡异的、怪诞的
custom.tip: 拼写易错：是 ei 不是 ie（weird 不是 wierd）。记法：weird 自己就很“怪”，连拼写都不按规矩

custom.en: to make someone feel uncomfortable or uneasy (informal)
custom.zh: 使某人感到发毛、不安、别扭
forms: 让某人心里发毛/不舒服
custom.tip: weird 当动词 + out → 让人发毛。X weirds me out = X 让我浑身不对劲

custom.en: light open shoes held on the foot by straps, worn in warm weather
custom.zh: 凉鞋（通常用复数）
examples: I need a pair of {sandals} for the beach.
我需要一双凉鞋去海滩。
It's too hot for sneakers — I'll wear {sandals}.
穿运动鞋太热了，我穿凉鞋。
custom.tip: 鞋子成双→常用复数 sandals。一双=a pair of sandals。凉鞋有带子固定，比人字拖更包脚

custom.en: light open shoes with a strap between the toes, often worn on the beach
custom.zh: 人字拖、夹脚拖
examples: 哪里能买便宜的人字拖？
custom.tip: flip-flop 模拟走路的啪嗒声。只有夹脚的 Y 带 → 沙滩拖，比 sandals 更简易

custom.en: a close friend (informal); also used to address a man you do not know
custom.zh: ①朋友、哥们儿、伙伴 ②(称呼)老兄、哥们儿（语气可友好可挑衅）
custom.tip: X buddy = 一起做 X 的“搭子”：workout/study/travel buddy。当面叫 buddy 要听语气：友好=哥们儿，冷冷地=挑衅“老兄”（影视常见）

custom.en: a paved outdoor area next to a house, used for sitting or eating outside
custom.zh: 露台、(铺砌的)户外平台/天井（常用于户外用餐）
examples: They have a nice {patio} for outdoor dining.
他们有个不错的露台可以户外用餐。
custom.tip: patio=地面铺砌、紧挨房子的户外区，常用于吃饭。区别：balcony 楼上阳台、terrace 大平台、deck 木台

custom.en: a platform sticking out from an upper floor of a building, enclosed by a wall or rail
custom.zh: 阳台（楼上悬空突出的）；(剧院)楼座
examples: I'd like a room with a {balcony}.
我想要一间带阳台的房间。
We watched the sunset from the {balcony}.
custom.tip: balcony=楼上悬空突出的阳台（patio 在地面）。订房常说 a room with a balcony 带阳台的房

custom.en: a barrier of wood, wire or metal that encloses an area of land
custom.zh: ①栅栏、围栏、篱笆(名词) ②围起来(动词) ③击剑(fencing) ④(俚语)销赃者
examples: They built a {fence} around the garden.
他们在花园周围建了栅栏。
他们把那块地围了起来。
custom.tip: fence 栅栏。引申习语 on the fence=骑在篱笆上、两边都不跳 → 犹豫不决（见短语）

custom.en: unable or unwilling to decide between two options; remaining neutral
custom.zh: 骑墙、犹豫不决、保持中立不表态
examples: I'm still {on the fence} about the trip.
我还在犹豫要不要去旅行。
Stop sitting {on the fence} and decide!
别再骑墙观望了，做个决定！
custom.tip: 画面：骑在篱笆上、哪边都不跳下去 → 拿不定主意/保持中立

custom.en: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted; (verb) to remove such plants; (slang) marijuana
custom.zh: ①杂草、野草 ②(动词)除草、拔草 ③(俚语)大麻
examples: I need to pull the {weeds} in the garden.
他们淘汰了不合格的申请者。
custom.tip: weed out=像拔杂草一样剔除 → 淘汰。注意：weed 在口语/影视里也是“大麻”的俚语

custom.en: a place where medicines are prepared and given out; (modern) a shop selling cannabis
custom.zh: ①药房、配药处、医务室 ②(现代)大麻专卖店
examples: There's a cannabis {dispensary} on every corner here.
The hospital {dispensary} is on the ground floor.
custom.tip: dispense（分发）+ -ary（…的场所）→ 配药的地方。-ary 表地点：library 图书馆、granary 谷仓

custom.en: widely recognized and admired as a symbol of something; very famous and representative
custom.zh: 标志性的、经典的、极具代表性的
examples: The Eiffel Tower is an {iconic} landmark.
埃菲尔铁塔是标志性地标。
那是个超经典的电影镜头。
custom.tip: icon（图标/偶像/标志）+ -ic（…的）→ 像标志一样的 = 标志性的、经典的。口语赞叹：That's iconic! 绝了！

custom.en: to cook food in hot oil or fat; (informal) to burn or overheat
custom.zh: ①煎、炸、油炸 ②(口语)暴晒/烧坏(设备) ③fries=薯条
forms: 油炸的（fried chicken 炸鸡、fried rice 炒饭）
examples: Can I get a side of {fries}?
The sun is {frying} me out here.
custom.tip: fry 发音像 cry/try。煎炸→fried（炸鸡 fried chicken、炒饭 fried rice）；薯条=French fries；煎锅=frying pan

custom.en: a small flying insect that bites people and animals and sucks their blood
custom.zh: 蚊子
examples: The {mosquitoes} are terrible at night here.
custom.tip: 西班牙语 mosca(苍蝇)+ -ito(小)→ “小飞虫”=蚊子。发音 muh-SKEE-toh，qu 读 /k/

custom.en: to cut or wound with the teeth; a mark or sore where an insect has bitten you
custom.zh: ①(动词)咬、叮 ②(名词)叮咬的包；咬一口
custom.tip: 不规则变化：bite-bit-bitten。蚊子包=mosquito bites；grab a bite=随便吃点（口语）

custom.en: to have an uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch it
custom.zh: ①(动词)发痒 ②(名词)痒 ③be itching to do=渴望做某事
examples: My mosquito bites are {itching} like crazy.
The skin on my arm is {itchy}.
custom.tip: itch 发音像 rich/which。itch→itchy（-y 后缀，痒的）。想挠=scratch；be itching to do=手痒/渴望做

custom.en: to raise to a higher position; (British) an elevator; a free ride in a vehicle
custom.zh: ①(动词)举起、抬起、提升 ②(英)电梯 ③搭便车(give sb a lift) ④(雾)消散
examples: Can you give me a {lift} to the airport?
Take the {lift} to the third floor.
The good news really {lifted} my spirits.
这好消息让我精神一振。
custom.tip: 核心“往上抬”→举起/提振/(英)电梯=美 elevator。give sb a lift=让人搭车，也=让人振奋。face-lift=拉皮/翻新

custom.en: to move smoothly along a surface; a structure children slide down; a single page of a presentation
custom.zh: ①(动词)滑动、下滑 ②滑梯 ③幻灯片 ④slides=一字凉拖
examples: The kids love the {slide} at the park.
custom.tip: 不规则：slide-slid-slid。幻灯片=slide（你做推广的演示）；推拉门=sliding door；slides=一字拖（接 sandals）；landslide victory=压倒性胜利

custom.en: lasting or intended to last for a long time or forever; not temporary
custom.zh: 永久的、永恒的、长期的（反义：临时的 temporary）
examples: Is this a {permanent} or temporary job?
这是长期还是临时的工作？
custom.tip: per-(贯穿/始终)+ man(留下，同 remain)+ -ent → 自始至终都留着 = 永久的。反义 temporary 临时的

custom.en: a thin thread of metal; to connect with wires; to send money electronically
custom.zh: ①(名词)金属丝、电线、铁丝 ②(动词)接线、布线 ③电汇(钱)
examples: I need to {wire} money to my account.
The game came down to the {wire}.
custom.tip: 发音像 fire/hire。金属丝→电线→(动词)接线/电汇。down to the wire=到最后一刻；get your wires crossed=误会；wired=(人)亢奋；wire transfer=电汇

custom.en: to take hold of something suddenly; (informal) to get quickly; to attract attention
custom.zh: ①抓住、一把抓 ②(口语)快速拿/吃/获取 ③抓住(机会/注意力)
custom.tip: grab→grabbing/grabbed 双写 b（短元音+单辅音规则）。grab a bite 随便吃；grab attention 抓眼球（你做文案常用）；up for grabs 可争抢

custom.en: a plant with small white sweet-smelling flowers, used in tea and perfume
custom.zh: 茉莉(花)
custom.tip: 源自波斯语 yasmin。发音 JAZ-min。泰国最有名的米就是 jasmine rice（茉莉香米）

custom.en: finely ground powder of specially grown green tea, used in drinks and desserts
custom.zh: 抹茶(日式绿茶粉)
custom.tip: 日语「抹茶」=磨碎的茶。发音 MAH-cha（别读成马查）。绿色粉状，常做 latte、冰淇淋、甜点

custom.en: a small piece of metal, plastic or cloth with a design or words on it, worn to show rank, membership, achievement or identity
custom.zh: ①徽章、胸牌、证章 ②(警察的)警徽、警牌 ③(游戏/App 里的)成就徽章、勋章 ④标志、象征
forms: 光荣的象征、引以为荣的标志
examples: Everyone wears a name {badge} at the event.
活动上每个人都戴姓名牌。
I just earned a new {badge} in the game.
我刚在游戏里赢得一枚新徽章。
She wears her scars as {a badge of honor}.
她把伤疤当作荣耀的象征。
You need to {badge in} to enter the office.
custom.tip: 结尾 -dge 发 /dʒ/，和 edge(边)、bridge(桥)、judge(法官)、fridge(冰箱) 同一拼写规律（短元音后用 dge）。记忆：警察“亮 badge”证身份；游戏/App 集 badge = 集勋章。a badge of honor = 引以为荣的标志

custom.en: the work needed to keep something in good condition; the act of keeping a state or relationship going; (law) money paid to support a family member
custom.zh: ①维护、保养（设备/建筑/系统）②维持、保持（状态/关系/秩序）③(法律)抚养费、赡养费
examples: Regular {maintenance} keeps the car running well.
定期保养能让车一直跑得好。
He pays monthly {maintenance} for his kids.
他每月支付孩子的抚养费。
她很好相处、不挑、很省心。
custom.tip: maintain = main(手 manus)+ tain(握 tenere) → 用手握住 → 保持、维护。⚠️拼写易错：动词 main·tain，名词变成 main·tenance（tain→ten，少了一个 i）。low/high-maintenance 形容人“省心/难伺候”很常用

custom.en: happening or produced four times a year, once every three months; also a magazine published four times a year
custom.zh: ①每季度的、按季的（形）②每季一次地（副）③季刊（名）
forms: 四分之一；一刻钟；季度；(美)25美分硬币
每季度的 / 每季度地
examples: We have a {quarterly} meeting every three months.
我们每三个月开一次季度会。
第一季度销售额上升了。
custom.tip: quarter = 四分之一 → 一年分四份 = 4 个季度（每季 3 个月）→ quarterly = 每季度（这里 -ly 既能当形容词也能当副词）。联想：美国的 quarter 硬币 = 25 美分（1 美元的四分之一）

custom.en: a large mass of stone; to move gently back and forth; a style of loud popular music; (informal) to be excellent
custom.zh: ①岩石、石头（名）②摇晃、摇动（动）③摇滚乐（名）④(口语)超棒、厉害 ⑤(情感上)震撼、动摇
forms: 多岩石的；(关系/局势)不稳的、艰难的
坚如磐石的、非常可靠的
(饮料)加冰块；(关系/生意)触礁、要垮
examples: We sat on a {rock} by the sea.
我们坐在海边一块石头上。
She gently {rocked} the baby to sleep.
I'll have a whisky {on the rocks}.
custom.tip: 一个 rock 串起好几层：石头 → 坚固（rock-solid 坚如磐石）；动词「摇」→ 摇滚乐（节奏摇摆）→ 口语「You rock! 你真棒」。on the rocks：字面「在礁石上」→ ①酒加冰（冰块像小石子）②船触礁 → 关系/生意「要垮了」

custom.en: to become or make something hard or harder; to make or become tougher, more determined, or less easily affected by emotion
custom.zh: ①(使)变硬、凝固 ②(态度/立场)变强硬、变坚定 ③(使)变冷酷/变坚强 ④(防御)加固
forms: 硬化的；老练的、铁石心肠的；惯犯的
examples: 被背叛后，他的态度变强硬了。
Years on the streets had {hardened} her.
街头多年的生活让她变得冷硬。
他是个惯犯/铁石心肠的罪犯。
custom.tip: harden = hard(硬) + -en（动词后缀「使变…」）。同规律：soft→soften 变软、wide→widen 变宽、sharp→sharpen 削尖、length→lengthen 加长。意思从「物理变硬」延伸到「态度变强硬、人心变冷硬、防御加固」

custom.en: to change information into a secret code so that only authorized people can read it
custom.zh: 加密（把信息转成密码，只有授权者能读）
examples: 你应该给敏感文件加密。
The data is stored in {encrypted} form.
这个 App 用端到端加密。
custom.tip: encrypt = en-（使进入）+ crypt（隐藏；希腊语 kryptos=hidden）。词根 crypt = 隐藏：cryptic 神秘难解的、crypto 加密货币、crypt 地下墓室。反义 decrypt（de- 去掉 → 解密）

custom.en: to fill something again; a second filling of a drink or container, or a replacement supply for something (pen, soap, medicine)
custom.zh: ①(动)重新装满、再充满 ②(名)续杯、再来一份 ③(名)替换装、补充装（笔芯/替芯）④(名)续药、续配的药
examples: This café offers free {refills} on coffee.
这家咖啡馆咖啡免费续杯。
I need a {refill} for my pen.
She {refilled} the bottle at the fountain.
她在饮水器那儿把瓶子重新装满。
I have to pick up a prescription {refill}.
custom.tip: refill = re-（再、重新）+ fill（装满）→ 再装满。前缀 re- = 再/重来：reload 重新加载、rewrite 重写、rebuild 重建。美国餐厅「free refill」= 软饮/咖啡免费续杯；笔或洗手液的 refill = 替芯/替换装

custom.word: 星期 · 全写 → 缩写
custom.zh: 一周七天的全称、缩写、中文（首字母都大写）
custom.tip: 星期首字母一律大写；缩写取前三个字母 + 点。Wednesday 读 /ˈwenzdeɪ/（第一个 d 不发音）。weekday 工作日、weekend 周末；“在星期几”用介词 on：on Monday

custom.word: 月份 · 全写 → 缩写
custom.zh: 十二个月的全称、缩写、中文（首字母都大写）
custom.tip: 月份首字母一律大写；缩写多为前三字母 + 点（May/June/July 本身短，May 一般不缩写）。“在某月”用介词 in：in July。February 读 /ˈfebruəri/ 别漏第一个 r

custom.word: 常用日期 & 时间表达
custom.zh: 日期写法、序数、时间介词 in / on / at
forms: 月 日, 年（读 July ninth, twenty twenty-six）
日 月 年（读 the ninth of July）
in 2026 / in July / in summer（年·月·季节）
on Monday / on July 9th / on my birthday
美 = 月/日/年，英 = 日/月/年
custom.tip: 介词口诀「in 大 · on 中 · at 小」：in 年/月/季节，on 日/星期/具体某天，at 钟点。日期读作序数（July 9 → July ninth）。写数字日期注意美英顺序相反：7/9 在美国是 7 月 9 日，在英国是 9 月 7 日

custom.word: 气候带 · 热带 / 温带 / 寒带
custom.zh: 从赤道到两极的气候带英文说法
forms: 热带的 /ˈtrɒpɪkl/（the tropics 热带地区）
examples: Most of China lies in the {temperate} zone.
custom.tip: 从赤道往两极：tropical 热带 → subtropical 亚热带 → temperate 温带 → frigid/polar 寒带/极地。tropic(名,回归线/热带)+ -al → tropical(形)。climate 气候(长期) ≠ weather 天气(当下)；赤道 equator、半球 hemisphere

custom.en: the part of the leg between the hip and the knee; on poultry, the dark meat of the upper leg
custom.zh: ①大腿 ②(禽类)腿肉、琵琶腿（chicken thigh 鸡腿肉）
examples: 比起鸡胸我更喜欢鸡腿肉。
He pulled a muscle in his {thigh}.
custom.tip: th 发 /θ/（咬舌）、gh 不发音。鸡肉部位：breast 鸡胸、thigh 琵琶腿、drumstick 小腿、wing 翅。thigh 肉比 breast 更嫩多汁

custom.en: not cooked; in a natural or unprocessed state
custom.zh: ①生的、未煮的 ②未加工的、原始的（raw data 原始数据）③(情感)赤裸的
examples: 这是未剪辑的原始素材。
custom.tip: raw = 生的/未加工。raw fish 生鱼、raw meat 生肉；引申 raw material 原料、raw data 原始数据、raw emotion 赤裸的情感。反义 cooked

custom.en: the yellow part in the middle of an egg
custom.zh: 蛋黄
custom.tip: yolk 里的 l 不发音，读 /jəʊk/（同音 yoke 轭）。蛋黄 yolk、蛋白 egg white、流心 runny、全熟 hard-boiled

custom.en: a herb with green leaves used in cooking, especially in Italian and Thai food
custom.zh: 罗勒、九层塔（香草）
custom.tip: 香草名。意式青酱 pesto 用罗勒；泰餐、三杯鸡用九层塔 Thai basil。发音英 /ˈbæzl/、美 /ˈbeɪzl/

custom.en: the soft part in the mouth used for tasting and speaking; a language; the tongue of an animal eaten as food
custom.zh: ①舌头 ②语言（mother tongue 母语）③(食材)牛舌、口条
custom.tip: 拼写不规则、读 /tʌŋ/（gue 不发音）。三义：舌头 → 语言(mother tongue 母语) → 食材(beef tongue 口条)。习语 slip of the tongue 口误、tongue-tied 张口结舌

custom.en: needing to be chewed a lot before it can be swallowed; pleasantly firm and elastic
custom.zh: 有嚼劲的、耐嚼的、黏牙的
custom.tip: chew(嚼) + -y → chewy（正是 -y 后缀规律卡那条）。口感词：chewy 有嚼劲、crispy 脆、tender 嫩、tough 老/硬

custom.en: any of the foods that are combined to make a dish; a component or element of something
custom.zh: ①食材、原料、配料 ②要素、因素
examples: Trust is a key {ingredient} of any team.
信任是团队的关键要素。
custom.tip: 食谱上的 ingredients = 配料表。引申「要素」：the key ingredient of success 成功的关键要素

custom.en: the soybean plant or its seeds; short for soy sauce
custom.zh: 大豆、黄豆；(=soy sauce)酱油
custom.tip: soy = 大豆，也常指酱油(soy sauce)。豆制品家族：soy milk 豆浆、tofu 豆腐、soybean 黄豆、soy sauce 酱油

custom.en: a drink made from soybeans, used as an alternative to cow's milk
custom.zh: 豆浆
examples: A cup of warm {soy milk}, please.
custom.tip: 植物奶系列：soy milk 豆浆、oat milk 燕麦奶、almond milk 杏仁奶、coconut milk 椰奶。早餐经典：豆浆油条 soy milk and fried dough sticks

custom.en: to cook meat or vegetables slowly in a small amount of liquid in a closed pot
custom.zh: 炖、焖、红烧（先煎上色再小火慢炖）
examples: We {braised} the beef for two hours.
我们把牛肉焖了两小时。
红烧五花肉是我的最爱。
custom.tip: braise = 先煎上色、再加汤汁小火慢炖(=红烧/焖)。braised pork 红烧肉。做法对比：braise 焖、stew 炖(全程泡汤里)、simmer 小火煨

custom.en: a person who works in a shop or keeps records in an office
custom.zh: ①店员、营业员 ②职员、办事员
examples: She works as a {clerk} in an office.
custom.tip: 英式读 /klɑːk/（卡克）、美式 /klɜːrk/（克勒克），差别大。store clerk 店员、desk clerk 前台、file clerk 档案员

custom.en: a fungus with a stem and a round top, many kinds of which can be eaten; (verb) to grow or increase very quickly
custom.zh: ①蘑菇、菌菇 ②(动)迅速增长、激增
custom.tip: 名词蘑菇；动词「像蘑菇一样冒出」=激增。常见菌菇：shiitake 香菇、enoki 金针菇、button mushroom 口蘑、oyster mushroom 平菇

custom.en: a small hot-tasting pepper; a sauce or dish made with chili
custom.zh: ①辣椒 ②辣椒酱、辣味料理
examples: 我爱在饺子上浇辣椒油。
custom.tip: chili(美)=chilli(英)=chile，都是辣椒。chili oil 红油、chili flakes 辣椒碎。美食里 heat = 辣度

custom.en: to cut food, especially meat, into very small pieces; (British) minced meat
custom.zh: ①(动)剁碎、绞碎 ②(名,英)肉末、绞肉
custom.tip: mince=剁碎/绞碎；minced garlic 蒜末、minced/ground meat 肉末。切法对比：chop 切碎(块大)、dice 切丁、mince 剁成末

custom.en: a black substance made by burning wood slowly, used as fuel or for drawing; a dark grey colour
custom.zh: ①木炭、炭 ②炭笔、炭画 ③炭灰色、深灰
custom.tip: charcoal：木炭(烧烤)、炭笔(画画)、炭灰色(颜色)。炭火烤 charcoal grill → 有炭香。加 -y = charcoaly 有炭味的(见 -y 规律卡)

custom.en: to soak meat, fish, or vegetables in a seasoned liquid before cooking to add flavour
custom.zh: 腌、腌制（用酱汁浸泡入味）
custom.tip: marinate(动词,腌) vs marinade(名词,腌料)——差一个字母，t=动作、e=东西。腌一晚 marinate overnight 更入味

custom.en: the fresh leaves of the coriander plant, used as a herb (American English)
custom.zh: 香菜、芫荽（美式；英式叫 coriander）
examples: Some people think {cilantro} tastes like soap.
有人觉得香菜有肥皂味。
custom.tip: 美式 cilantro、英式 coriander(叶)；coriander 在英式还指芫荽籽。有人基因上觉得香菜像肥皂味

custom.en: the front part of the body below the chest; the fatty meat from a pig's underside
custom.zh: ①肚子、腹部 ②(食材)五花肉（pork belly）
examples: He has a bit of a beer {belly}.
custom.tip: belly 肚子(比 stomach 口语)。pork belly 五花肉(做红烧肉/培根)、belly button 肚脐、beer belly 啤酒肚

custom.en: (of food) soft and easy to cut or chew; gentle and loving; sore when touched
custom.zh: ①(肉/菜)嫩的、软的 ②温柔的、体贴的 ③(伤处)一按就痛的
custom.tip: tender 三义：肉嫩(反义 tough 老)、人温柔、伤处触痛。tenderloin 里脊(最嫩部位)、tenderize 把肉捶松弄嫩

custom.en: a pleasant, noticeable smell, especially of food, coffee, or spices
custom.zh: 香气、芳香（尤指食物、咖啡、香料的诱人气味）
examples: The {aroma} of coffee filled the room.
咖啡的香气弥漫了房间。
I love the {aroma} of fresh bread.
custom.tip: aroma = 好闻的香气(多指食物/咖啡/香料，比 smell 更正面)。形容词 aromatic 芳香的。近义 fragrance 芬芳、scent 气味

custom.en: small pieces of pork cooked on a stick over a grill
custom.zh: 烤猪肉串
custom.tip: kebab(英)/kabob(美)=烤肉串，串在 skewer(扦子)上。拆解 grilled(烤的)+pork(猪肉)+kebabs(串)。类似 lamb kebab 羊肉串、chicken skewers 鸡肉串

custom.en: to cook food on a metal frame over fire or heat; a metal frame for grilling; (informal) to question someone closely
custom.zh: ①(动)炙烤、烧烤 ②(名)烤架 ③(口语)盘问、拷问
custom.tip: grill 用烤架/明火直接烤(有焦痕)。区分：grill 明火烤、roast 烤箱烘烤、bake 烤面包甜点、broil 上火烤。口语 grill sb = 盘问

custom.en: a deep round container used for cooking; a container for plants or drinks
custom.zh: ①锅、罐、壶 ②一锅(的量) ③花盆
examples: Put the soup in a big {pot}.
custom.tip: pot 锅/壶/罐(有深度)。hot pot 火锅、teapot 茶壶、flower pot 花盆。对比 pan 平底锅(浅)

custom.en: a thin flat cake made from batter and fried on both sides
custom.zh: 薄煎饼、烙饼、松饼
custom.tip: pancake 煎饼(西式松饼配枫糖；中式葱油饼 scallion pancake)。flip a pancake 翻煎饼。相关 crepe 可丽饼(更薄)、waffle 华夫饼

custom.en: having a pleasant smell
custom.zh: 香的、芬芳的（气味好闻）
custom.tip: fragrant(形)香的 / fragrance(名)香味、香水。多形容花、茶、米饭、香料。近义 aromatic 芳香。反义 smelly/stinky 臭的

custom.en: pleasantly hard, dry, and easily broken; crisp
custom.zh: 脆的、酥脆的（口感）
examples: 我喜欢培根煎得特别脆。
custom.tip: crisp + -y → crispy(见 -y 规律卡)。口感词：crispy 酥脆、crunchy 咯吱脆(更硬)、chewy 有嚼劲、tender 嫩。英式 crisps=薯片

custom.en: a powder made by grinding grain, used to make bread, cakes, etc.
custom.zh: 面粉
custom.tip: flour(面粉) 和 flower(花) 同音 /ˈflaʊə/，别拼错。种类：all-purpose 中筋(美)、plain 普通(英)、whole wheat 全麦、glutinous rice flour 糯米粉

custom.en: sticky, like glue; (of rice) sticky when cooked
custom.zh: 黏的、有黏性的、糯的（glutinous rice 糯米）
custom.tip: glutinous 黏糯(glutinous rice 糯米=sticky rice)。词根 gluten 面筋/麸质。口语近义 sticky。糯米做：粽子、汤圆、年糕、麻糬 mochi

custom.en: made in a way that is true to the original; genuine and real
custom.zh: ①正宗的、地道的 ②真实的、真品的、可信的
custom.tip: authentic：正宗/地道(食物)、真品/真实(物件、情感)。authentic cuisine 地道菜、authentic leather 真皮。名词 authenticity。反义 fake

custom.en: not pleasant to taste; (of an idea or fact) difficult to accept
custom.zh: ①难吃的、不好吃的 ②(事实/观点)难以接受的
custom.tip: un-(不)+palatable(可口的)=难吃/难接受。词根 palate 味觉。引申 unpalatable truth 逆耳的真相。反义 palatable/tasty

custom.en: having a strong unpleasant smell
custom.zh: 臭的、发臭的
custom.tip: stink(发臭)+-y → stinky(见 -y 规律卡)。stinky tofu 臭豆腐(闻着臭吃着香)。口语 stinky 也指「烂/糟」。近义 smelly

custom.en: a table or small shop where things are sold, often at a market; (verb) to stop working, or to delay
custom.zh: ①摊位、货摊、小摊 ②(动)熄火、抛锚；拖延、停滞
custom.tip: stall 两大意思：①摊位(food stall 小吃摊、market stall 集市摊)②熄火/拖延(engine stalls 熄火、stall for time 拖延时间)

custom.en: to move away from the right place or path; (of an animal) lost and having no home
custom.zh: ①(动)走失、偏离、走神 ②(形)走失的、流浪的 ③(名)流浪动物
examples: 一只流浪狗跟我回了家。
custom.tip: stray 走失/偏离 → 流浪的(stray dog 流浪狗)、跑题(stray from the topic)、走神(mind strays)。近义 wander 漫游、roam 游荡

custom.en: to cook food in an oven or over a fire; (informal) to criticize or mock someone in a playful way
custom.zh: ①(动)烤、烘（烤箱/明火烤肉、烘咖啡豆）②烤肉、烘焙度 ③(口语)吐槽、调侃
examples: 他们在派对上狂调侃他。
custom.tip: roast 烤箱/明火慢烤(整鸡、坚果、咖啡豆)。对比 grill 烤架直烤、bake 烤面包甜点。dark roast 深烘咖啡。口语 roast sb = 花式吐槽

custom.en: a rope or wire on which washed clothes are hung to dry
custom.zh: 晾衣绳
examples: She hung the shirts on the {laundry line}.
她把衬衫晾在晾衣绳上。
The {laundry line} stretched across the alley.
custom.tip: laundry line = clothesline 晾衣绳。laundry 指要洗/洗好的衣物：do the laundry 洗衣、hang out the laundry 晾衣、laundromat 自助洗衣店

custom.en: a round tropical fruit with a thick purple rind and sweet white segments inside
custom.zh: 山竹（果后）
examples: 山竹里是清甜的白色果肉瓣。
Peel the purple rind to eat {mangosteen}.
custom.tip: 山竹外号 the queen of fruits(果后，和榴莲「果王」相对)。紫色硬壳、白色蒜瓣状果肉、酸甜。别和 mango 芒果搞混

custom.en: a very large tropical fruit with a spiky green skin and sweet yellow flesh
custom.zh: 菠萝蜜
examples: 菠萝蜜是最大的树生水果。
撕碎的菠萝蜜常当素肉。
custom.tip: jackfruit 菠萝蜜(超大、带刺外皮)；熟的很甜，未熟的 young jackfruit 口感像肉、做素食「拉肉」。别和 durian 榴莲、pineapple 菠萝搞混

custom.en: a sweet juicy tropical fruit with yellow-orange flesh and a large flat stone
custom.zh: 芒果
custom.tip: mango 芒果，复数 mangoes 或 mangos 都行。泰式甜点 mango sticky rice 芒果糯米饭。ripe 熟的、juicy 多汁、stone/pit 果核

custom.en: a large tropical fruit with soft orange flesh and small black seeds
custom.zh: 木瓜（番木瓜）
examples: {Papaya} is orange inside with black seeds.
Green {papaya} salad is spicy and sour.
custom.tip: papaya 木瓜(橙红果肉、黑籽)。泰式 green papaya salad(青木瓜沙拉,Som Tam)。和港式炖汤的「木瓜」是同一种

custom.en: a small red tropical fruit with a hairy skin and sweet translucent flesh
custom.zh: 红毛丹
examples: Peel the {rambutan} to reach the flesh.
custom.tip: rambutan 红毛丹(名字来自马来语 rambut=毛发)。红色带软刺的壳、里面像荔枝的半透明果肉。近亲：lychee 荔枝、longan 龙眼

custom.en: a small round tropical fruit with translucent flesh, related to the lychee
custom.zh: 龙眼、桂圆
examples: 龙眼味道像清淡版荔枝。
custom.tip: longan 龙眼(字面 dragon eye 龙之眼)，晒干=桂圆(dried longan)，煲汤/甜品用。和 lychee 荔枝、rambutan 红毛丹是近亲

custom.en: a small sweet fruit with a rough red skin and juicy white flesh around a large seed
custom.zh: 荔枝
custom.tip: lychee(也拼 litchi)荔枝，红色带疙瘩的壳、白色多汁果肉、大核。近亲 longan 龙眼、rambutan 红毛丹。「一骑红尘妃子笑」说的就是它

custom.en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice; (informal) something that is defective, especially a car
custom.zh: ①柠檬 ②(口语)次品、老出毛病的东西(尤指车)
custom.tip: lemon 柠檬(黄、酸)；lemonade 柠檬水。口语 a lemon = 花钱买的次品/老出毛病的东西(尤指车)。区分 lime 青柠(绿、更小)

custom.en: a round citrus fruit with a thick skin and sweet juicy flesh; the colour orange
custom.zh: ①橙子 ②橙色(的)
custom.tip: orange 既是橙子也是橙色。橙汁 orange juice(缩写 OJ)。橘子/柑用 mandarin、tangerine。冷知识：先有水果 orange，才有颜色词 orange

custom.en: a long curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft sweet flesh
custom.zh: 香蕉
custom.tip: banana 香蕉；一串 a bunch of bananas。习语 go bananas = 发疯/抓狂/兴奋失控。banana peel 香蕉皮(经典滑倒梗)

custom.en: a large tropical seed with a hard hairy shell, white flesh, and clear liquid inside
custom.zh: 椰子
custom.tip: coconut 椰子。区分：coconut water 椰子水(清)vs coconut milk 椰浆(浓，做咖喱甜品)。coconut oil 椰子油。白色果肉 coconut flesh/meat

custom.en: a tropical cactus fruit with bright pink skin and white or red flesh dotted with tiny black seeds
custom.zh: 火龙果
examples: {Dragon fruit} is dotted with black seeds.
火龙果里布满黑色小籽。
The pink skin makes {dragon fruit} striking.
粉红外皮让火龙果很显眼。
custom.tip: dragon fruit(学名 pitaya/pitahaya)火龙果，仙人掌类果实。粉红带「鳞片」的皮、白肉或红肉、布满芝麻状黑籽、口味清淡

custom.en: a round tropical fruit with green skin and pink or white flesh, crunchy and mildly sweet
custom.zh: 番石榴、芭乐
custom.tip: guava 番石榴(台湾叫芭乐)。绿皮、白肉或粉红肉、脆口微甜、维C高。台式吃法：切块蘸梅子粉/甘草粉

custom.en: a brown pod containing sour-sweet pulp, used as a souring agent in cooking
custom.zh: 罗望子、酸豆、酸角
examples: Pad Thai gets its sourness from {tamarind}.
泰式炒河粉的酸味来自罗望子。
custom.tip: tamarind 罗望子/酸豆(豆荚里的酸果肉)。做调味：泰餐 Pad Thai、酸汤、酱料的酸味来源。tamarind paste 罗望子酱。酸中带甜

custom.en: a soft food made by boiling grains such as rice or oats in water or milk
custom.zh: 粥、麦片粥
examples: Rice {porridge} is easy on the stomach.
custom.tip: porridge 泛指粥/麦片粥；米粥常叫 congee(源自泰米尔语)、燕麦粥 oatmeal。稀=thin、稠=thick

custom.en: a muscular part of a bird's stomach that grinds food; eaten as offal
custom.zh: (禽类)胗、肫（鸡胗等）
examples: 鸡胗是常见的街头小吃。
custom.tip: gizzard 禽类的「胗/肫」(磨碎食物的肌胃)，常烤或卤，口感脆弹。属于 offal 内脏/下水。鸡胗 chicken gizzards

custom.en: a large organ in the body; the liver of an animal eaten as food
custom.zh: ①肝脏 ②(食材)肝、猪肝/鸡肝
examples: I don't like the taste of {liver}.
custom.tip: liver 既是器官「肝脏」也是食材「肝」(猪肝 pork liver、鸡肝 chicken liver)。法式肝酱 pâté。补铁常吃

custom.en: the seeds of food plants such as rice and wheat; a single small hard piece
custom.zh: ①谷物、粮食 ②一粒（谷/沙）③纹理
custom.tip: grain 谷物(rice/wheat/corn)，也指「一粒」(a grain of sand 一粒沙)、木头的「纹理」(against the grain 逆纹/违背本性)。whole grain 全谷物

custom.en: very thin noodles, often made from rice or mung bean starch
custom.zh: 粉丝、细面、米粉（细如线的面）
custom.tip: vermicelli 极细的面/粉丝(意大利语「小虫子」)。rice vermicelli 米粉、绿豆粉丝=glass noodles/cellophane noodles(透明)。多用泡软再煮

custom.en: a shellfish with a rough shell, eaten raw or cooked; some produce pearls
custom.zh: 牡蛎、生蚝、蚝
custom.tip: oyster 生蚝/牡蛎(可生吃)。oyster sauce 蚝油(炒菜提鲜)、蚵仔煎 oyster omelette。习语 the world is your oyster 世界任你闯

custom.en: a shellfish with a dark blue-black shell that can be eaten
custom.zh: 青口、贻贝、淡菜
custom.tip: mussel 青口/贻贝(蓝黑色壳)，白酒/蒜蓉蒸很经典。和 oyster 生蚝、clam 蛤蜊、scallop 扇贝同属贝类。注意 mussel≈muscle(肌肉)同音

custom.en: a shellfish similar to a large shrimp, eaten as food
custom.zh: 大虾、明虾、对虾
custom.tip: prawn(英式常用)≈shrimp(美式常用)，prawn 一般更大。king prawn 大明虾、tiger prawn 虎虾。冬阴功汤 Tom Yum Goong 的 goong 就是虾

custom.en: a small shellfish with a long tail, eaten as food
custom.zh: 虾、小虾、虾仁
custom.tip: shrimp(美式)≈prawn(英式,更大)。dried shrimp 虾米、shrimp paste 虾酱(东南亚常用)。美式 shrimp 单复数常同形

custom.en: an oily sea fish with a strong flavour, eaten as food
custom.zh: 鲭鱼、青花鱼
custom.tip: mackerel 鲭鱼/青花鱼(油脂多、味浓的海鱼)。和 herring 鲱鱼、sardine 沙丁鱼都是常见青皮小海鱼。单复数同形

custom.en: a small silver sea fish that is used for food
custom.zh: 鲱鱼
examples: Pickled {herring} is common in Nordic food.
腌鲱鱼是北欧常见食物。
那条线索是故意误导的。
custom.tip: herring 鲱鱼(银色小海鱼)。习语 red herring = 转移注意力的假线索/障眼法(源自用熏鲱鱼气味引开猎犬)。腌鲱鱼 pickled herring

custom.en: a root similar to ginger, used in Southeast Asian cooking
custom.zh: 南姜、高良姜（似姜的香料根）
examples: 冬阴功用的是南姜，不是姜。
南姜气味辛香带柑橘味。
custom.tip: galangal 南姜/高良姜，长得像姜但更硬、味更辛香带柑橘，是泰国冬阴功、咖喱的灵魂香料。别和普通 ginger 姜搞混

custom.en: a hot-tasting root used as a spice; a reddish-brown colour
custom.zh: ①姜、生姜 ②姜黄(红棕)色；红发的
custom.tip: ginger 姜(去腥暖身)。ground ginger 姜粉、pickled ginger 姜片(寿司配)。也指「姜黄/红棕色」，ginger hair = 红头发。近亲 galangal 南姜

custom.en: a small green citrus fruit that tastes sour
custom.zh: 青柠、酸橙（绿色小柑橘）
forms: 青柠檬叶用的青柠(泰餐)
custom.tip: lime 青柠(绿、小、更酸)，区别于 lemon 柠檬(黄、大)。泰餐/东南亚菜的酸味多来自 lime。kaffir lime 青柠(叶子做香料)

custom.en: a dark red root vegetable eaten cooked or raw
custom.zh: 甜菜根、红菜头
examples: 烤甜菜根有泥土香、微甜。
custom.tip: beetroot(英)=beet(美) 甜菜根，深红色、微甜带土味，会染色。常烤、煮、打汁。别和 radish 萝卜搞混

custom.en: a green leafy vegetable with curly leaves, popular as a health food
custom.zh: 羽衣甘蓝
examples: 早餐来杯羽衣甘蓝奶昔。
custom.tip: kale 羽衣甘蓝(深绿卷叶，网红健康菜)。Chinese kale=芥蓝。近亲 cabbage 卷心菜、broccoli 西兰花、spinach 菠菜

custom.en: young shoots of beans or seeds eaten as vegetables; (verb) to begin to grow
custom.zh: ①豆芽、嫩芽 ②(动)发芽、长出
custom.tip: sprout 动词「发芽」，名词「嫩芽/芽菜」。bean sprouts 豆芽(绿豆芽 mung bean sprouts)、Brussels sprouts 抱子甘蓝(小卷心菜)

custom.en: a small green bean, used to grow bean sprouts and to make desserts
custom.zh: 绿豆
examples: {Mung bean} soup cools you down in summer.
Glass noodles are made from {mung bean}.
custom.tip: mung bean 绿豆。发的芽=绿豆芽 bean sprouts、淀粉做粉丝 glass noodles、绿豆汤 mung bean soup 解暑、绿豆沙做甜品

custom.en: a soft round fruit with smooth skin and a stone in the middle
custom.zh: 李子、梅子；梅子色
examples: Guava with {plum} powder is a Taiwan snack.
芭乐蘸梅子粉是台湾小吃。
custom.tip: plum 李子/梅子(晒干=prune 西梅/梅干)。plum powder 梅子粉(蘸水果)、plum sauce 梅子酱。习语 a plum job = 美差

custom.en: a small soft dark red or purple fruit that grows on a tree; the tree's leaves feed silkworms
custom.zh: 桑葚；桑树
custom.tip: mulberry 桑葚(深紫红、易染色、酸甜)；桑树的叶子 mulberry leaves 喂蚕(silkworm)产丝。别和 blueberry 蓝莓、raspberry 覆盆子搞混

custom.en: a thin soup made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water; stock
custom.zh: 清汤、高汤、汤底
custom.tip: broth/stock 高汤、汤底(熬肉骨/菜得来的清汤)。broth 常可直接喝，stock 多做基底。bone broth 骨汤。近义 soup 是成品汤

custom.en: a thick mixture of flour and liquid used to make bread, noodles, etc.; (slang) money
custom.zh: ①面团 ②(俚)钱
examples: Let the {dough} rise for an hour.
custom.tip: dough 面团(读 /dəʊ/，gh 不发音)。knead 揉、rise/proof 发酵。俚语 dough=钱(=bread)。区分 batter 面糊(更稀，倒得动)

custom.en: a thin pointed stick used to hold pieces of food while cooking
custom.zh: ①(烤肉的)扦子、串 ②(动)串起来、刺穿
custom.tip: skewer 串肉的扦子(竹签 bamboo/铁签 metal)，动词=串起/刺穿。串好的烤=kebab 烤串。街边烤串常论「串」skewers 卖

custom.en: damaged or spoiled by fire or heat; cooked too much
custom.zh: 烧焦的、烤糊的
examples: I {burnt} my tongue on the soup.
custom.tip: burnt=burned 烧焦的(英式偏 burnt)。burnt toast 烤焦的吐司、burnt smell 焦味。引申 burnt out 累垮。焦香(可口)= charred/smoky

custom.en: having a large distance between two sides; not thin; (of liquid) not flowing easily
custom.zh: ①厚的 ②(液体)浓稠的 ③(树林/人群)密的
custom.tip: thick 厚/浓/密。反义 thin 薄/稀。加 -en → thicken 勾芡、变浓稠。习语 thick and thin 风雨同舟、a thick accent 很重的口音

custom.en: a desire for food; a strong wish or liking for something
custom.zh: ①食欲、胃口 ②欲望、兴致（an appetite for…）
examples: He has a big {appetite} for risk.
custom.tip: appetite 食欲/胃口，引申「对…的强烈欲望」(an appetite for adventure)。开胃菜 appetizer、开胃的 appetizing。lose one's appetite 没胃口

custom.en: looking or smelling good enough to make you want to eat it
custom.zh: 开胃的、诱人的、让人有食欲的
custom.tip: appetizing 让人有食欲的(看着/闻着诱人)。反义 unappetizing 倒胃口。同根 appetite 食欲、appetizer 开胃菜。近义 tempting、mouth-watering 令人垂涎

custom.en: connected with cooking or the kitchen
custom.zh: 烹饪的、厨艺的、餐饮的
custom.tip: culinary=和烹饪/厨房有关的(书面词)。culinary arts 烹饪艺术、culinary school 厨艺学校、culinary tradition 饮食传统。比 cooking 更正式

custom.en: your name written in your own way; (adjective) that is a special, characteristic thing someone is known for
custom.zh: ①签名、署名 ②招牌的、代表性的（signature dish 招牌菜）
examples: Tom Yum is the chef's {signature} dish.
冬阴功是这位厨师的招牌菜。
custom.tip: signature 签名；作形容词=「招牌的、标志性的」——signature dish 招牌菜、signature style 标志性风格、signature move 招牌动作

custom.en: to cook gently in liquid just below boiling point
custom.zh: ①小火慢煮、煨、炖 ②(情绪)暗暗酝酿
custom.tip: simmer 小火微沸慢煮(水面冒小泡，不是大滚 boil)。火候：boil 大滚 > simmer 微沸 > poach 低温慢煮。引申 simmer with anger 怒火中烧、simmer down 消气

custom.en: an activity or skill involving making things by hand; (verb) to make something skilfully
custom.zh: ①手艺、工艺 ②(动)精心制作 ③(不变)小船/飞行器
custom.tip: craft 手艺/工艺，动词=精心打造(a well-crafted story)。craftsman 工匠、craftsmanship 匠心。craft beer 精酿啤酒。另义:aircraft 飞行器(单复数同形)

custom.en: the inner surface of the hand; a tall tropical tree with large leaves
custom.zh: ①手掌 ②棕榈树、椰树
examples: He held the coin in his {palm}.
custom.tip: palm 两义：手掌(l 不发音 /pɑːm/) + 棕榈树(热带)。palm oil 棕榈油、palm tree 棕榈/椰树。习语 read sb's palm 看手相、palm sth off 蒙混塞给

custom.en: to make an action or process easier or possible
custom.zh: 促进、使便利、协助推动
examples: 这个 App 方便了在线支付。
custom.tip: facilitate=让某事更容易/更顺(书面)。facilitator 会议主持/协调人。同根 facility 设施。近义 ease、enable、promote。反义 hinder 阻碍

custom.en: preserved in vinegar or salt water
custom.zh: 腌渍的、泡的（醋渍或盐渍）
custom.tip: pickle 用醋/盐水腌渍保存 → pickled 腌渍的。pickled vegetables 泡菜、pickled ginger 姜片。区分 marinate 是入味腌(不为保存)

custom.en: a long channel of water dug across land for boats or irrigation
custom.zh: 运河、水渠
custom.tip: canal 人工挖的运河/水渠(vs river 天然河)。重音在后 /kəˈnæl/。以运河众多闻名的城市常称 Venice of the East 东方威尼斯

custom.en: a person who sells things, especially on the street or at a market
custom.zh: 小贩、摊主、卖家、供应商
examples: 一个街头小贩卖给我们面。
custom.tip: vendor 卖家/摊贩(street vendor 街头小贩、food vendor 食品摊)。也指公司「供应商」。近义 seller、hawker 叫卖小贩、stall 摊位

custom.en: the lower edges of a roof that stick out beyond the wall
custom.zh: 屋檐、房檐
custom.tip: eaves 屋檐(伸出墙外的屋顶边缘，常用复数)。有趣词源：eavesdrop 偷听 = 站在「屋檐滴水」范围内听墙角

custom.en: a basic food that is eaten regularly; a main or important element; a small metal fastener for paper
custom.zh: ①主食 ②主要的、必备的 ③订书钉
custom.tip: staple：①主食/必备品(rice is a staple)②形容词「主要的」(staple diet 主要饮食)③订书钉(stapler 订书机)。一词三义靠语境

custom.en: belonging to or inherited from ancestors; passed down through generations
custom.zh: 祖先的、祖传的、世代相传的
custom.tip: ancestral 祖传的/世代相传的。ancestor 祖先(反义 descendant 后代)、ancestry 血统。ancestral recipe 祖传配方、ancestral home 祖宅

custom.en: a seat without a back or arms
custom.zh: 凳子、板凳（无靠背的）
examples: We sat on plastic {stools} by the street.
我们坐在街边的塑料小凳上。
custom.tip: stool 无靠背的凳子(有靠背的是 chair)。bar stool 高脚凳、footstool 搁脚凳。街边大排档常用矮塑料凳 plastic stool

custom.en: a film or TV programme that gives facts about a real subject
custom.zh: 纪录片
examples: 我看了一部美食纪录片。
一部关于街头美食的纪录片
custom.tip: documentary 纪录片(讲真实题材)。同根 document 文件、记录。docuseries 纪录剧集、footage 影像素材。区分 movie 剧情片

custom.en: salt, pepper, herbs, or spices added to food to improve its flavour
custom.zh: 调味料、佐料；调味
examples: 这道菜需要多加点调料。
custom.tip: season 动词=调味，seasoning=调味料/调味的动作。盐、胡椒、香料都算。seasoned 还指「老练的」(a seasoned traveler 老练的旅行者)

custom.en: a savoury, meaty taste, considered one of the basic tastes
custom.zh: 鲜味（第五种基本味）
custom.tip: umami 鲜味(来自日语「旨味」)，五味之一：甜 sweet、酸 sour、咸 salty、苦 bitter、鲜 umami。来源：酱油、菌菇、番茄、海带、味精 MSG

custom.en: to make something denser or more concentrated; (of gas) to change into liquid; to make text shorter
custom.zh: ①浓缩 ②(气)冷凝、凝结 ③(把内容)压缩、精简
custom.tip: condense 三义：浓缩(condensed milk 炼乳)、冷凝(水汽 condensation 凝结)、把文字压缩精简。词根 dense 密的

custom.en: very comfortable, expensive, and of high quality
custom.zh: 奢华的、豪华的；(口感)醇厚享受的
custom.tip: luxurious 奢华的(名词 luxury 奢侈/奢侈品)。形容酒店、生活，也可形容口感醇厚享受。近义 lavish、opulent。反义 modest、plain

custom.en: having a sharp acid taste like a lemon; (of milk) no longer fresh; (of a relationship) turning unfriendly
custom.zh: ①酸的 ②(奶)馊的、变质的 ③(关系)变糟
examples: The soup is a bit too {sour}.
custom.tip: sour 酸(五味之一)、也指奶「馊了」(go sour)。引申 go sour = 关系/事情变糟。sour cream 酸奶油。区分 tart 酸爽、tangy 酸香、bitter 苦

custom.en: the pleasant feeling you get when you achieve or get what you wanted
custom.zh: 满足、满意、满足感
custom.tip: satisfaction 满足感/满意(动词 satisfy、形容词 satisfying 令人满足的)。customer satisfaction 客户满意度。反义 dissatisfaction 不满

custom.en: a small amount you can hold between finger and thumb; to squeeze skin tightly between finger and thumb
custom.zh: ①一撮、少许 ②(动)捏、掐
custom.tip: a pinch of… 一小撮(食谱常见:a pinch of salt/sugar)。动词 pinch=捏/掐。习语 take it with a pinch of salt 半信半疑、in a pinch 紧要关头

custom.en: to make a long, loud, deep sound, like a lion or an engine
custom.zh: ①咆哮、吼叫 ②(引擎/人群)轰鸣、呼啸、喧闹
custom.tip: roar 低沉洪亮的声音：狮吼、引擎轰鸣、人群喧闹、大笑(roar with laughter)。the roar of the crowd 观众的喧闹。近义 rumble 隆隆声

custom.en: famous and admired for something
custom.zh: 著名的、有名望的、久负盛名的
examples: The city is {renowned} for its food.
custom.tip: renowned 著名的(常搭 renowned for 以…闻名)。名词 renown 声望。近义 famous、celebrated、acclaimed。比 famous 更书面、更带敬意

custom.en: to make someone want to do or have something, especially something they should not
custom.zh: 引诱、诱惑、勾起…的欲望
examples: The smell {tempted} me to buy some.
custom.tip: tempt 引诱/勾起欲望。tempting 诱人的(a tempting offer)、temptation 诱惑(resist temptation 抵抗诱惑)。美食语境=让人嘴馋

custom.en: extremely beautiful, delicate, and finely made
custom.zh: 精致的、精美的、细腻的
custom.tip: exquisite 精致细腻、精美绝伦(形容艺术品、工艺、摆盘、味道)。比 beautiful 更强调「精细讲究」。近义 delicate、refined、elegant

custom.en: twisted or closely connected together
custom.zh: 交织的、缠绕在一起的、紧密相连的
examples: 他们的人生紧紧交织在一起。
custom.tip: inter-(相互)+twine(缠绕)=intertwine 交织。intertwined 常形容抽象的「密不可分」(cultures/fates intertwined)。近义 interwoven、interconnected

custom.en: to leave something in liquid, or to become completely wet
custom.zh: ①浸泡、泡（软/入味）②浸湿、湿透
custom.tip: soak 浸泡(泡软 vermicelli、泡入味)、也指湿透(soaked to the skin 浑身湿透)。soak up 吸收(汤汁/阳光/知识)。近义 immerse、drench

custom.en: to go into or through something; (of flavour) to soak deeply in
custom.zh: ①穿透、渗透、进入 ②(味道)入味、渗入
custom.tip: penetrate 穿透/渗透(物理:光、水;也指味道入味 the flavour penetrates)。penetrating look 锐利的目光。市场语境 penetrate a market 打入市场

custom.en: to scatter small drops or pieces of something over a surface
custom.zh: 撒、洒（少量地）
custom.tip: sprinkle 撒/洒少量(芝麻、葱花、糖粉、盐)。sprinkle A with B 或 sprinkle B on A。蛋糕上的彩色糖针也叫 sprinkles。近义 scatter、dust

custom.en: a substance in food that living things need to grow and stay healthy
custom.zh: 营养素、养分
custom.tip: nutrient 营养素(蛋白/维生素/矿物质等)。nutritious 有营养的、nutrition 营养(学)、nutritionist 营养师。nutrient-rich 营养丰富的

custom.en: pleasantly full and rounded; slightly fat in an attractive way
custom.zh: 饱满的、圆润的、丰满的（褒义的胖）
custom.tip: plump 饱满圆润(褒义,形容虾、水果、饺子、也委婉形容人「丰满」，比 fat 客气)。plump up a pillow 把枕头拍鼓。近义 rounded、full

custom.en: covered with or containing a lot of oil or fat
custom.zh: 油腻的、多油的、油乎乎的
custom.tip: grease(油脂)+-y → greasy 油腻的(见 -y 规律卡)。cut through the greasiness = 解腻(酸味/茶常用来解腻)。greasy spoon 廉价小餐馆

custom.en: more liquid than usual; flowing easily
custom.zh: ①流动的、稀的（流心的）②(鼻子)流鼻涕的
custom.tip: run(流)+-y → runny 流动/稀的(见 -y 规律卡)。runny yolk 流心蛋黄、runny honey 稀蜂蜜、runny nose 流鼻涕。反义 thick 稠、set 凝固

custom.en: to fry small pieces of food quickly over high heat while stirring; a dish cooked this way
custom.zh: ①(动)爆炒、快炒 ②(名)一道炒菜
custom.tip: stir(搅)+fry(煎炸)=stir-fry 大火快炒、不停翻动(用 wok 炒锅、镬气 wok hei)。做法对比：deep-fry 油炸、pan-fry 煎、steam 蒸

custom.en: the front part of the body between the neck and the stomach; the white meat from the front of a bird
custom.zh: ①胸部、胸膛 ②(食材)胸脯肉（chicken breast 鸡胸肉）
custom.tip: breast 胸部；禽类的「胸脯肉」(chicken breast 鸡胸=白肉 white meat，瘦、易柴)。对比 thigh 琵琶腿(深色肉,更嫩多汁)

custom.en: to continue something so that it develops or progresses; to move a total to a later time
custom.zh: ①传承、延续下去 ②(账目)结转到下期
examples: 他们把祖传食谱传承下去。
Losses can be {carried forward} to next year.
custom.tip: carry forward：把传统/精神「延续、传承下去」；财会里=把余额「结转」到下期。近义 pass down 世代相传、carry on 继续

custom.en: practical, sensible, and honest; not pretentious
custom.zh: 脚踏实地的、朴实的、接地气的
examples: She's famous but very {down to earth}.
custom.tip: down to earth 脚踏实地/朴实不做作/接地气(形容人或做法)。近义 grounded、practical、unpretentious。反义 pretentious 装腔作势、aloof 高冷

custom.en: starting from the inside and spreading outward; thoroughly and fundamentally
custom.zh: 由内而外；从根本上、彻底地
examples: The soup warms you {from the inside out}.
这汤让你从里到外都暖起来。
custom.tip: from the inside out 由内而外(暖/发光/改变从内部开始扩散)。相关 inside out：①里朝外(wear a shirt inside out 衣服穿反)②彻底(know it inside out 了如指掌)

custom.en: (of a quality, answer, or reason) to exist in or be found in something
custom.zh: 在于、存在于（关键/秘诀在于…）
custom.tip: lie in = (某种品质/答案/原因)「在于、存在于」。常用句型 the secret/key/answer/beauty lies in… 秘诀/关键/答案/妙处在于…。注意用 lies(第三人称)

custom.en: a nickname for a city with many canals and waterways, like Bangkok
custom.zh: 东方威尼斯（水城别称，如曼谷）
examples: Bangkok is called the {Venice of the East}.
曼谷被称为东方威尼斯。
Its canals earned it the name {Venice of the East}.
众多运河让它得名东方威尼斯。
custom.tip: Venice of the East 东方威尼斯——因运河/水道众多而得名的城市美称(曼谷、苏州等都被这么叫过)。同类:Paris of the East 东方巴黎

custom.en: a hot and sour Thai soup made with prawns, lemongrass, galangal, and lime
custom.zh: 冬阴功（泰式酸辣虾汤）
examples: {Tom Yum Goong} is hot, sour, and aromatic.
A bowl of {Tom Yum Goong}, please.
custom.tip: Tom Yum 冬阴(酸辣)，Goong 是泰语「虾」→ 冬阴功=酸辣虾汤。灵魂香料：lemongrass 香茅、galangal 南姜、kaffir lime 青柠叶、chili 辣椒

custom.en: thick, very sweet milk with sugar added, sold in cans
custom.zh: （甜）炼乳
examples: Thai iced tea uses {sweetened condensed milk}.
custom.tip: sweetened condensed milk 甜炼乳(浓稠、超甜，罐装)。区分 evaporated milk 淡奶(浓缩但无糖)。东南亚咖啡、奶茶、甜点常用炼乳

custom.en: a large, ornate former royal residence, such as the one in Bangkok
custom.zh: 大皇宫（如曼谷大皇宫）
examples: We toured the {Grand Palace} in Bangkok.
我们游览了曼谷大皇宫。
Dress modestly to enter the {Grand Palace}.
custom.tip: Grand Palace 大皇宫(曼谷著名景点，旧王宫)。grand=宏伟的、palace=宫殿。旁边是玉佛寺 Temple of the Emerald Buddha。参观需着装端庄

custom.zh: 常见颜色英文 + 真实色块对照
forms: 浅 / 深 / 淡（light blue 浅蓝）
custom.tip: 美式 color = 英式 colour。深浅：light 浅 / dark 深 / pale 淡 / bright 鲜艳（light green 浅绿、dark red 深红）。发音坑：beige /beɪʒ/、turquoise /ˈtɜːkwɔɪz/、purple /ˈpɜːpl/。gray(美)=grey(英)

custom.en: a hard yellowish-brown material formed from fossilized tree resin, used in jewellery; a honey-yellow colour; (UK) the yellow traffic light
custom.zh: ①琥珀（树脂化石，做首饰）②琥珀色、蜜黄色 ③(英)交通黄灯
forms: 安珀警报(失踪儿童紧急警报)
custom.tip: amber 琥珀(古树脂化石，有时里面封着小昆虫)→ 引申「琥珀色/蜜黄色」。英式交通「黄灯」叫 amber(美式常说 yellow)。Amber Alert 安珀警报(失踪儿童)。也是常见英文名

custom.en: an important topic or problem for debate; one of a regular series of a magazine; (verb) to officially give out or publish
custom.zh: ①问题、议题、争议点 ②(报刊)一期、期号 ③(动)发行、发放、发布 ④(复)心结、毛病
custom.tip: issue 一词多义：核心「问题/议题」→「(报刊)一期」→ 动词「发行/发放」(issue a passport/tickets)。口语 have issues 有心结/毛病。⚠️别和 tissue 纸巾搞混，只差开头一个 t

custom.en: a soft piece of paper used for blowing your nose; (biology) a group of cells that form part of a body
custom.zh: ①纸巾、面巾纸 ②(生物)组织
custom.tip: tissue 两义：纸巾(a box of tissues)、生物「组织」(muscle/scar tissue)。和 issue /ˈɪʃuː/ 押韵、只差开头一个 t —— 一对易混词一起记：issue 问题、tissue 纸巾

custom.word: 交通 · 工具 / 路况 / 上下车
custom.zh: 交通工具、堵车路口、上下车说法与美英差异
forms: 小汽车 / 公交 / 出租(=cab)
火车 / 飞机 / 渡轮
自行车 / 摩托 / 踏板电动车
卡车（美 truck = 英 lorry）
堵车（rush hour 早晚高峰）
红绿灯（英 traffic lights 常用复数）
绿灯（go 走；也指“批准放行”）
斑马线、人行横道（英 zebra crossing）
上 / 下（公交、地铁、火车、飞机）
上 / 下（小汽车、出租车）
examples: We got stuck in a {traffic jam}.
custom.tip: 「乘…」用 by：by car/bus/train/plane（但步行是 on foot）。上下车分两种：大交通(公交/地铁/火车/飞机)用 get on/off；小车(小汽车/出租车)用 get in/out。换乘 transfer、通勤 commute。🚦红绿灯：等红灯 wait at a red light、闯红灯 run a red light；give sb the green light = 给某人开绿灯/批准。美英差异：subway(美)=tube(英)、truck(美)=lorry(英)、highway(美)=motorway(英)、amber(英)=yellow(美)

custom.en: on or to a lower floor of a building, especially the floor at ground level
custom.zh: ①(副)在楼下、往楼下、下楼 ②(形)楼下的 ③(名)楼下(那一层)
forms: 楼下的（the downstairs bathroom 楼下的卫生间）
custom.tip: down(向下)+stairs(楼梯)=downstairs 楼下，反义 upstairs 楼上。⚠️它本身已含介词意味，**不说 in downstairs / to downstairs**，直接 go downstairs、be downstairs。类似构词：indoors 室内、outdoors 户外、downtown 市中心

custom.en: a small group of words that has a meaning but is not a complete sentence; (verb) to express something in a particular way
custom.zh: ①短语、词组 ②说法、措辞 ③(动)表达、措辞 ④(音乐)乐句
custom.tip: phrase 短语（有意义但不是完整句子）。三层区分：**word 词 < phrase 短语 < sentence 句子**；clause 从句(含主谓)。动词 phrase=措辞，how you phrase it 你怎么说很关键。phrasal verb 短语动词、catchphrase 口头禅

custom.word: 酒店 · 房型 / 入住 / 设施
custom.zh: 订房、入住退房、房内设施与常用请求
forms: 单人房 / 双人房（一张大床）
双床房（两张单人床）⚠️别和 double 搞混
套房 /swiːt/（发音同 sweet，不读“斯威特”）
入住 / 退房（名词 check-in time）
洗漱用品（牙刷、沐浴露等）
custom.tip: ⚠️三个高频坑：①double room 是「一张大床」，要两张床得说 twin room；②suite 套房读 /swiːt/（和 sweet 同音）；③check in/out 动词分开写，名词连字符 check-in time。实用句：I have a reservation under… 我用…的名字订了房 / Can I leave my luggage here? 行李能先寄存吗？

custom.word: 场景对话 · 餐厅点餐
custom.zh: 进店→点餐→用餐→买单，对方怎么问、你有几种回法
forms: Do you have a table available?
Could we have a few more minutes?
What soft drinks do you have?
Could I get some more water?
Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered.
不好意思，这不是我点的。
Could I have the bill, please?
Can I have this to go?
custom.tip: 服务员那三问几乎每次都一样：几位 → 点餐吗 → 喝什么。答不上来时万能拖延句：Could we have a few more minutes?。买单英式 bill、美式 check；打包 to go(美)/takeaway(英)。叫服务员用 Excuse me，别喊 waiter

custom.word: 场景对话 · 酒店入住
custom.zh: 前台怎么问、你怎么答，加上房间有问题时的说法
forms: No. Do you have any rooms available?
Could you send up some towels?
Could I have a late checkout?
Can I leave my luggage here?
custom.tip: 前台三连问基本固定：有预订吗 → 看护照 → 住几晚，答案短就行。报预订名用 under + 名字。房间任何东西坏了都能套：The … isn't working.。提要求统一用 Could I / Could you…（比 Can 礼貌）

custom.word: 场景对话 · 问路 & 打车
custom.zh: 你怎么问、对方会怎么答、听不懂怎么办
forms: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
It's about ten minutes on foot.
Sorry, could you say that again?
Could you show me on the map?
能在地图上指给我看吗？
How much is it to the airport?
examples: How do I {get to} the station?
Could you {show me on the map}?
能在地图上指给我看吗？
custom.tip: 问路万能开头 Excuse me, how do I get to…?（比 Where is 自然）。听不懂别硬撑，直接 Could you show me on the map? 最有效。打车最省事：把地址给司机看 + This address, please.

custom.word: 场景对话 · 购物 & 付款
custom.zh: 店员搭话、试穿、砍价、结账的几种回法
forms: Yes, I'm looking for a jacket.
Do you have this in a larger size?
I'm not sure. Can I try it on?
Could you give me a discount?
How would you like to pay?
custom.tip: 不想被店员跟着，一句 I'm just looking, thanks. 就够（万能挡箭牌）。决定买说 I'll take it；不想买说 I'll think about it（礼貌收场）。砍价委婉版：Is that your best price?

custom.word: 场景对话 · 机场 & 出入境
custom.zh: 值机、安检、入境官问答，标准答法
forms: What's the purpose of your visit?
custom.tip: 入境三连问永远这三个：目的 → 待多久 → 住哪。答案用短语就行，不用完整句（Tourism. / Ten days. / At a hotel.）。行李词：carry-on 随身、checked baggage 托运、baggage claim 提取处

custom.word: 场景对话 · 求助 & 应急
custom.zh: 听不懂、不舒服、丢东西时的几种说法
forms: Could you say that again, please?
I need to see a doctor.
custom.tip: 没听清千万别只说 What?（听起来很冲），用 Sorry, I didn't catch that. 最自然。身体不适万能句型：I have a…（headache/fever/cough）或 My … hurts.。洗手间美式 restroom、英式 toilet

custom.word: 票务 · 车票 / 火车 / 机票
custom.zh: 买票、乘车、登机的核心词汇
forms: 票（ticket office 售票处、ticket machine 自助售票机）
单程 / 往返（英式 single / return）
车费、票价（票价也可说 ticket price）
出发 / 到达（车站大屏上的两栏）
车站 / 公交站（火车站 train station）
站台（英式；美式常用 track 轨道号）
座位号（aisle 过道 / window 靠窗）
换乘 / 转机（connecting flight 联程航班）
登机牌（boarding time 登机时间）
随身行李 / 托运行李
经济舱 / 商务舱 / 头等舱
custom.tip: 单程往返：美式 one-way/round-trip，英式 single/return。站台英式 platform、美式 track。「转」都用 transfer(换乘)/connection(转机)。退票 refund、改签 change my ticket。时刻表 schedule 英美读音不同：/ˈskedʒuːl/ vs /ˈʃedjuːl/

custom.word: 场景对话 · 买票（车票 / 机票）
custom.zh: 售票窗口怎么问、你怎么答，加改签退票说法
forms: When would you like to travel?
What time does the next train leave?
custom.tip: 买票万能三句：One ticket to ___, please. → One-way. → What time does it leave?。售票员基本只问三件事：去哪、单程往返、什么时候。票没了别慌：When's the next available one? 问下一班

custom.word: 洗澡 · 浴室 / 用品 / 泡汤
custom.zh: 洗澡动作、浴室设施、洗浴用品与泡汤文化
forms: 洗澡（淋浴）美式 take、英式 have
洗头（不说 wash my head）
浴室、卫生间（美式 restroom = 公共厕所）
搓澡、去角质（搓澡巾 scrub towel）
custom.tip: ⚠️三个常见错：①洗澡是 take/have a shower，**不说 wash a shower**；②洗头说 wash my hair，不说 wash my head；③水龙头英 tap、美 faucet。淋浴 shower vs 泡澡 bath 分清。酒店要东西万能句：Could I get another towel / some shampoo?

custom.zh: 常见水果英文 + 图片对照
custom.tip: 买水果实用句：How much per kilo? 一公斤多少钱 / Is this ripe? 这个熟了吗 / Can I try one? 能尝一个吗。状态词：ripe 熟的、unripe 生的、overripe 过熟、fresh 新鲜、in season 当季。⚠️注意 kiwi 在新西兰也指人/鸟，水果全称 kiwifruit

custom.en: to grow or develop successfully; to wave something in the air to attract attention
custom.zh: ①繁荣、兴旺、蓬勃发展 ②(植物)茂盛生长 ③挥舞、炫耀地展示 ④(名)华丽的动作、点缀
examples: 这里的街头美食文化很繁荣。
植物在这种气候下长得茂盛。
He signed his name {with a flourish}.
他龙飞凤舞地签下名字。
custom.tip: flour(花 flos)→ 像花一样绽放 → 繁荣、茂盛。⚠️别和 flour 面粉搞混（拼写只差一个 i，发音也不同）。近义 thrive、prosper、boom

custom.en: to give a person, animal, or plant the food needed to live and grow; to support a feeling or idea
custom.zh: ①滋养、给…营养 ②养育、培养 ③怀有(希望/情感)
examples: 她一直怀着回去的希望。
custom.tip: nourish 滋养(身体/心灵/土壤)。和 nutrient 营养素、nutrition 营养 同源(拉丁 nutrire 喂养)。⚠️和 flourish 押韵好记：nourish 滋养 → flourish 繁茂（先养后旺）

custom.en: (of a thick liquid) to flow out slowly; to show a quality strongly
custom.zh: ①(浓稠液体)缓缓流出、渗出 ②(名)渗出的黏液 ③(比喻)散发出(魅力/自信)
examples: The cheese {oozes} out of the burger.
巧克力从中间流了出来。
custom.tip: ooze = 浓稠液体「慢慢淌出来」（芝士、巧克力、蜂蜜、酱汁），美食视频高频词。比喻用法 ooze confidence/charm = 浑身散发自信/魅力。对比 drip 滴、pour 倒、seep 渗

custom.en: to become liquid because of heat; (of feelings) to become gentler
custom.zh: ①融化、熔化 ②(心)软下来、被融化 ③(食物)入口即化
custom.tip: melt 融化(固体→液体)。melted cheese 融化的芝士、melt in your mouth 入口即化(夸食物嫩)。比喻:心软 my heart melted。相关 ooze 渗出、gooey 黏软拉丝

custom.en: a soft sweet paste used to decorate cakes; a dessert with a soft melting centre
custom.zh: ①翻糖（裹蛋糕的糖皮）②熔岩蛋糕（chocolate fondant 流心巧克力蛋糕）
examples: 熔岩蛋糕中间是流心的。
custom.tip: 来自法语 fondre「融化」(同源 fondue 芝士火锅)。两义：①翻糖(捏造型的糖皮)②chocolate fondant 流心熔岩蛋糕。糖霜叫 icing(英)/frosting(美)

custom.en: a substance that flows freely, like water; not solid or gas
custom.zh: ①液体（名）②液态的、流动的（形）③(资产)易变现的
custom.tip: 物质三态：solid 固体 → liquid 液体 → gas 气体。dish liquid 洗洁精、liquid diet 流食。金融里 liquid = 流动性好、易变现

custom.en: a container with a handle and a lip, used for pouring liquids
custom.zh: (带柄带嘴的)壶、罐、水壶
examples: Could we have a {jug} of water?
custom.tip: jug 带把手、有倒嘴的壶(英式常用)；美式同款多说 pitcher。measuring jug 量杯。对比 kettle 烧水壶、teapot 茶壶、mug 马克杯

custom.en: a pleasant smell; a smell left by an animal or person
custom.zh: ①气味、香味 ②香水 ③(动物留下的)踪迹、气味线索
examples: The {scent} of jasmine filled the air.
茉莉香气弥漫在空气中。
custom.tip: scent 香味(s 不发音的是 c，读 /sent/，和 sent 寄出、cent 分 同音！)。香味三兄弟：scent 气味、fragrance 芬芳、aroma 食物香气。scented candle 香薰蜡烛

custom.en: a flat piece of plastic, metal, or wood used for carrying food or drinks
custom.zh: 托盘、盘子、(烤箱)烤盘
examples: Put the cookies on a baking {tray}.
He carried the drinks on a {tray}.
custom.tip: tray 平的托盘/烤盘。baking tray 烤盘、ice tray 冰格、in-tray 收件盘。⚠️和 try 尝试 拼写只差一个字母，注意区分

custom.en: to satisfy your thirst by drinking; to put out a fire
custom.zh: ①解渴 ②扑灭(火) ③平息(欲望)
custom.tip: quench 最常见搭配就是 quench your thirst 解渴（几乎固定搭配）。也可指扑灭火焰 quench the flames。饮料广告词常用 thirst-quenching

custom.en: feeling that you want to drink something
custom.zh: ①口渴的 ②(土地)干旱的 ③渴求的(thirsty for…)
custom.tip: thirst(渴)+-y → thirsty（见 -y 规律卡）。th 发 /θ/ 咬舌。渴 thirsty / 饿 hungry 一对。thirsty for knowledge 求知若渴。解渴 quench your thirst

custom.en: to make something very dry, especially by heat; (parched) extremely thirsty
custom.zh: ①(使)烤干、晒干 ②(parched)极渴的、干得要命
custom.tip: parched 比 thirsty 更夸张，口语里 I'm parched! = 我渴死了（英式常用）。也形容土地干裂 parched earth。程度：thirsty < parched

custom.en: a period of physical exercise
custom.zh: 锻炼、健身训练（一次运动）
examples: I {work out} three times a week.
custom.tip: ⚠️名词连写 workout，动词分开写 work out：I do a workout / I work out。健身房词：gym 健身房、reps 次数、sets 组数、warm up 热身、cool down 放松

custom.en: exercise that makes your heart beat faster, such as running or cycling
custom.zh: 有氧运动（跑步、单车等）
custom.tip: cardio 是 cardiovascular(心血管的)的简称 → 让心率上去的运动。两大类：cardio 有氧(跑步/单车/跳绳) vs strength training / weights 力量训练(举铁)

custom.en: a machine for walking or running while staying in one place
custom.zh: ①跑步机 ②(比喻)一成不变的苦差事、原地打转
examples: 我在跑步机上跑了五公里。
custom.tip: tread(踩)+mill(磨坊)→ 踩着走的机器。比喻义：the daily treadmill = 每天重复的枯燥生活（原地打转、不进不退）

custom.en: a short bar with weights at each end, lifted for exercise
custom.zh: 哑铃
custom.tip: dumb(哑的)+bell(钟)→ 哑铃(早期像不会响的钟)。区分：dumbbell 哑铃(单手一只)、barbell 杠铃(长杆)。举铁 lift weights / do weights

custom.en: to bend into a curved shape; (fitness) an exercise bending the arm to lift a weight
custom.zh: ①卷曲、蜷缩 ②(名)卷发、卷 ③(健身)弯举（bicep curl 二头弯举）
examples: The cat {curled} up on the sofa.
custom.tip: curl 核心义「卷」→ 卷发 curly hair、蜷缩 curl up、健身「弯举」(把哑铃卷起来的动作)。bicep curl 练二头肌

custom.en: the large muscle at the front of the upper arm
custom.zh: 二头肌（上臂前侧的肌肉）
custom.tip: bi-(二)+ceps(头)=二头肌；tri-(三)+ceps=三头肌 tricep。前臂 forearm、肩 delts、胸 pecs、背 lats。⚠️muscle 的 c 不发音 /ˈmʌsl/

custom.en: short for latissimus dorsi, the broad muscles of the back
custom.zh: 背阔肌（健身俚语，全称 latissimus dorsi）
custom.tip: 健身房肌肉简称大全：lats 背阔肌、pecs 胸肌、abs 腹肌、delts 三角肌、quads 股四头、glutes 臀。都是复数形式常用

custom.en: to move quickly up or back after hitting a surface; to be full of energy
custom.zh: ①弹起、反弹 ②蹦跳 ③(名)弹性、弹力 ④(邮件)被退回
custom.tip: bounce 弹跳。bounce back = 从挫折/生病中恢复过来(超实用)。bouncy 有弹性的(见 -y 规律卡)。邮件退回也叫 the email bounced

custom.en: to go towards a place
custom.zh: 过去、前往（口语，往某处走）
custom.tip: head 作动词=朝…去(比 go 更口语自然)。一组：head over to 过去、head to 前往、head out 出门、head back 回去、head home 回家。over 强调「从这边过去那边」

custom.en: not firmly fixed; not tight; free from control
custom.zh: ①松的、宽松的 ②松动的、没固定的 ③放开的、自由的
custom.tip: ⚠️经典易混：loose /luːs/ 松的(形容词) vs lose /luːz/ 丢失(动词)——多一个 o 的是「松」，发音 s 也不同。loose + -en → loosen 放松(见构词规律)

custom.en: (British) a knitted piece of clothing for the upper body; (American) a sleeveless dress
custom.zh: ①(英)套头毛衣、卫衣 ②(美)背带裙 ③跳跃者
custom.tip: ⚠️英美差异大：英式 jumper = 套头毛衣(=美式 sweater)；美式 jumper 却是「背带裙」。安全说法用 sweater。相关 hoodie 连帽衫、cardigan 开衫

custom.en: cold enough to be uncomfortable; (of a person) unfriendly
custom.zh: ①微冷的、凉飕飕的 ②(态度)冷淡的
custom.tip: chill(寒意)+-y → chilly(见 -y 规律卡)。⚠️和 chili 辣椒 发音几乎一样 /ˈtʃɪli/，靠拼写和语境区分！温度程度：cool 凉爽 < chilly 微冷 < cold 冷 < freezing 冻死

custom.en: a long loose piece of clothing, especially one worn after a bath or for ceremonies
custom.zh: ①浴袍、睡袍 ②(仪式用)长袍、礼袍
examples: He put on a {robe} after the shower.
custom.tip: robe 宽松长袍：酒店的浴袍(bathrobe)、法官/毕业礼袍。睡袍英式叫 dressing gown。相关 gown 礼服(evening gown 晚礼服)

custom.en: a soft bag filled with material, used to sit on or lean against; to soften an impact
custom.zh: ①靠垫、坐垫、抱枕 ②(动)缓冲、减轻(冲击)
custom.tip: ⚠️区分：cushion 靠垫/坐垫(沙发上)vs pillow 枕头(床上睡觉)。动词义=缓冲(cushion the blow 减轻打击)。鞋垫缓震也叫 cushioning

custom.en: a piece of cloth hung to cover a window or divide a space
custom.zh: ①窗帘、帘子 ②(剧院)幕布
custom.tip: ⚠️draw the curtains 既能指「拉上」也能指「拉开」，靠语境判断(想明确就说 open/close the curtains)。shower curtain 浴帘、blackout curtain 遮光帘

custom.en: a large piece of thick cloth used to keep warm in bed; a thick covering layer
custom.zh: ①毯子、毛毯 ②(覆盖的)一层 ③(形)全面的、一刀切的
custom.tip: blanket 毯子(盖在被子外或单用)。比喻:a blanket of snow/fog 一层雪/雾。形容词义=全面的、不加区分的(blanket ban 一刀切禁令)。酒店常用句：an extra blanket 加一条毯子

custom.en: a soft flat bag filled with feathers or other material, used on a bed
custom.zh: 羽绒被、被芯（英式常用）
custom.tip: duvet 来自法语，读 /ˈduːveɪ/（t 不发音）。英式 duvet = 美式 comforter。被套 duvet cover。床品全套：sheet 床单、pillowcase 枕套、duvet cover 被套

custom.en: one of the light soft parts covering a bird's body
custom.zh: 羽毛
custom.tip: feather 羽毛(读 /ˈfeðə/，ea 发短音 /e/)。⚠️别和 feature 特点 混（只差一个字母！）。习语 birds of a feather flock together 物以类聚。羽绒是 down(细绒毛)

custom.en: an important part or characteristic of something; (verb) to include as an important part
custom.zh: ①特点、特色、功能 ②(复)五官、相貌 ③(动)以…为特色、由…主演
examples: 这个 App 有个新功能。
custom.tip: ⚠️和 feather 羽毛 只差一个字母，一起记：feature /ˈfiːtʃə/ 特点、feather /ˈfeðə/ 羽毛。音乐里 feat. = featuring 由…参与演唱

custom.en: given free, especially by a business; expressing praise
custom.zh: ①免费赠送的（酒店/航空常用）②赞美的、恭维的
custom.tip: ⚠️经典易混对：compl**i**mentary 免费的/赞美的 vs compl**e**mentary 互补的。酒店/航班上看到 complimentary = 免费送的。餐厅免费招待也说 on the house

custom.en: to force liquid out in a thin fast stream
custom.zh: ①(液体)喷出、挤出 ②(名)一小股、少量挤出的量
custom.tip: squirt 细流状喷出/挤出(酱料、柠檬汁、洗手液)。a squirt of ketchup 挤一点番茄酱。对比 squeeze 挤压(动作)、spray 喷雾、pour 倒

custom.en: a machine or container that gives out a fixed amount of something
custom.zh: 分配器、按压瓶、自动售货/取用机
examples: I need a hair gel {dispenser} on my belt.
我腰带上得挂个发胶按压瓶。
custom.tip: dispense(分发)+-er → dispenser 定量给出东西的装置：soap dispenser 洗手液瓶、water dispenser 饮水机、cash dispenser 取款机(英式)

custom.en: a strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist; a band in a machine
custom.zh: ①腰带、皮带 ②(机器)传送带 ③(地理)地带
custom.tip: belt 腰带 → 引申传送带 conveyor belt、安全带 seat belt、地带(the Rust Belt 铁锈地带)。习语 tighten one's belt 勒紧裤腰带过日子

custom.en: to make a hole in something with a sharp object; to go through sharply
custom.zh: ①刺穿、扎孔 ②(声音/光)穿透 ③打耳洞
forms: 打了洞的（pierced ears 打了耳洞）
examples: 微波前把保鲜膜扎几个孔。
custom.tip: pierce 用尖东西扎穿。ear piercing 打耳洞、piercing 身体穿孔。形容词 piercing = 刺耳的(声音)、锐利的(眼神 piercing eyes)。近义 puncture 戳破、penetrate 穿透

custom.en: a chemical used to kill bacteria in swimming pools and drinking water
custom.zh: 氯（泳池、自来水消毒用）
custom.tip: chlorine 氯(读 /ˈklɔːriːn/，ch 发 /k/)。泳池消毒剂，闻起来「一股泳池味」。相关 bacteria 细菌、bleach 漂白剂、disinfect 消毒

custom.en: very small living things, some of which cause disease
custom.zh: 细菌（复数；单数 bacterium）
examples: 肥皂能杀死大部分细菌。
custom.tip: ⚠️bacteria 是复数！单数是 bacterium(少用)。所以说 bacteria are…不是 is。区分 bacteria 细菌(可用抗生素) vs virus 病毒(抗生素无效)

custom.en: a ring-shaped float thrown to someone in the water to keep them afloat
custom.zh: 救生圈
custom.tip: 救生装备一组：life ring/lifebuoy 救生圈、life jacket/vest 救生衣、lifeguard 救生员、float 浮板。泳池/船上标识常见

custom.en: an area of water for swimming; a small area of liquid; a shared supply of resources
custom.zh: ①游泳池 ②水洼、一滩 ③(共用的)资源池、拼用 ④台球(美式)
examples: a {pool} of water on the floor
custom.tip: pool 游泳池(swimming pool)。引申「池/共用」：car pool 拼车、talent pool 人才库、gene pool 基因库。美式 pool 还指台球(play pool)

custom.en: in or to a lower position than something; not good enough for someone
custom.zh: ①在…下面、在…之下 ②(比喻)配不上、有失身份
examples: 这种活儿有失他的身份。
custom.tip: beneath 比 under 更书面/文学，常用于比喻(beneath the surface 表象之下)。一组「下面」：under 最通用、below 位置更低、underneath 正下方、beneath 书面/比喻

custom.en: a very tall building in a city
custom.zh: 摩天大楼
examples: 这座城市满是摩天大楼。
custom.tip: sky(天空)+scraper(刮的东西)→ 高到「刮到天」的楼。相关 skyline 天际线(城市轮廓)、high-rise 高层楼、observation deck 观景台

custom.en: happening naturally, without being planned or forced
custom.zh: ①自发的、即兴的、临时起意的 ②自然而然的
examples: 那是个临时起意的决定。
custom.tip: spontaneous 没计划、自然发生的(即兴旅行 a spontaneous trip、自发掌声)。形容人=随性洒脱。反义 planned 有计划的、deliberate 刻意的

custom.en: a small picture that represents a larger image or video; the nail on your thumb
custom.zh: ①(视频/图片的)缩略图、封面图 ②拇指甲 ③(形)极简的、缩略的
examples: 这视频封面很吸引点击。
custom.tip: thumb(拇指)+nail(指甲)→ 拇指甲大小的小图 = 缩略图/视频封面(YouTube 高频词)。⚠️thumb 的 b 不发音 /θʌm/。thumbnail sketch = 简要概述

custom.en: to cause something to start; the part of a gun you pull; (informal) to cause a strong emotional reaction
custom.zh: ①(动)引发、触发 ②(名)扳机、触发器 ③(口语)被戳到痛处的、破防的
forms: 被触发的；(口语)破防的、被戳中的
custom.tip: trigger 扳机 → 引发、触发(a chain reaction 连锁反应)。网络口语 triggered = 被戳到痛处、破防、破大防。trigger warning 内容预警

custom.en: especially; in a way that is noticeable and important
custom.zh: ①尤其是、特别是（举例）②显著地、明显地
examples: Many cities, {notably} Bangkok, have great street food.
很多城市，尤其是曼谷，街头美食很棒。
custom.tip: notably 两用：①举突出例子=尤其是(= especially、in particular)②程度=明显地。同根 notable 值得注意的、noteworthy 值得一提的

custom.en: past form of light: burning or switched on; (slang) exciting or excellent
custom.zh: ①点燃的、亮着的（light 的过去式/分词）②(俚语)超嗨的、太赞了
custom.tip: light 的过去式 lit(也可用 lighted)。well-lit 光线好的、dimly lit 昏暗的。年轻人俚语 lit = 超嗨/超赞(That concert was lit!)

custom.en: a place where people go to drink alcohol and meet friends, especially in Britain
custom.zh: 酒吧、酒馆（英式，全称 public house）
examples: Let's grab a pint at the {pub}.
custom.tip: pub = public house 的缩写(英式，氛围偏休闲、供餐)；bar 更泛指(美式常用，偏喝酒)。pub crawl = 一晚连逛好几家酒吧。喝一杯啤酒 a pint

custom.en: the central and most important part of a place or activity; a device connecting devices
custom.zh: ①中心、枢纽（交通/商业中心）②(设备)集线器 ③轮毂
examples: 新加坡是重要的金融中心。
custom.tip: hub 原指车轮的「轮毂」(中心)→ 引申枢纽/中心：transport hub 交通枢纽、tech hub 科技中心、hub airport 中转枢纽机场。近义 center、center point

custom.en: a place serving alcoholic drinks; a long piece of solid material; to block or prohibit
custom.zh: ①酒吧 ②条、块（a bar of chocolate）③栏杆、横杆 ④(动)阻挡、禁止 ⑤(标准)门槛
custom.tip: bar 一词多义：酒吧、长条(a bar of soap)、栏杆、动词「禁止」。习语 raise the bar 提高标准、behind bars 坐牢(铁窗后)。健身房里 barbell 杠铃也是这个 bar

custom.en: towards the front or the future; to send something on to another person
custom.zh: ①向前、往前（副/形）②(动)转发(邮件) ③(足球)前锋
custom.tip: ⚠️正确拼写是 forward，不是 foward（少了 r 是常见笔误）。高频短语 look forward to + 名词/动名词（to 是介词！所以说 look forward to seeing you，不是 to see）

custom.word: Right now I'm crossing the road.
custom.zh: 我正在过马路。
custom.tip: 现在进行时 be + V-ing，表示「此刻正在做」。cross the road 过马路(cross 是及物动词，不加 over)。相关：crosswalk 斑马线、traffic light 红绿灯、jaywalk 乱穿马路。口语常用 right now 强调此刻

custom.zh: 该练起来了 / 是时候健身了。
custom.tip: Time to + 动词原形 = 「该做…了」（省略了 It's）。get fit = 变得健康有型(fit 形容词=健康结实的)。同类：Time to go 该走了、Time to eat 该吃饭了。相关 stay fit 保持身材、work out 健身

custom.word: We'll head over to the machines.
custom.zh: 我们待会儿过去器械区。
custom.tip: 健身房场景：machines 指器械(区)，free weights 指自由重量(哑铃杠铃)。head over to = 过去某处(口语，比 go to 自然)。we'll = we will 表示接下来要做

custom.zh: 名词加 -y → “有…味 / …感的”形容词
forms: weedy 杂草多的/(人)瘦弱的
custom.tip: 两条拼写规则：①以 e 结尾去掉 e → spice→spicy、smoke→smoky、ice→icy；②短元音+单辅音要双写 → crab→crabby、fat→fatty、sun→sunny。以后遇到 -y 的词我继续往这加

custom.zh: 重读“短元音+单辅音”结尾 → 加 -ing/-ed/-er 时双写末尾辅音
custom.tip: 规则：①一个元音字母+一个辅音字母结尾 ②该音节重读 → 双写辅音再加词尾。例外：w/x/y 不双写（snow→snowing、fix→fixing）；非重读不双写（open→opening）；以 e 结尾改为去 e（make→making）

custom.zh: 形容词去 -t 加 -ce → 抽象名词
examples: 我佩服她的耐心和自信。
custom.tip: 规律：-ant→-ance，-ent→-ence（基本是把 t 换成 ce）。再加 -ly 还能变副词：abundant→abundantly。遇到这类词我继续往这加

custom.en: existing or available in large quantities; plentiful
custom.zh: 大量的、充足的、丰富的（= plentiful）
examples: There's an {abundance} of fresh fruit here.
custom.tip: 词根 und=浪（inundate 淹没）→ ab+und+ant 像波浪涌出 → 大量。谐音 a bundle 一大捆 → 很多。反义：scarce 稀少

custom.en: (of food) served separately from the main dish
custom.zh: （酱、配料）另外放、单独上
examples: Can I get the sauce {on the side}?
酱可以单独给我一份吗？
I'd like the dressing {on the side}.
custom.tip: 配料放盘子“旁边(side)”、不直接淋上去 → on the side

custom.en: to spend time relaxing or socializing (informal)
custom.zh: 一起玩、闲逛、消磨时间
examples: Do you want to {hang out} tonight?
We just {hung out} at the café.
我们就在咖啡馆待着聊天。
custom.tip: hang(挂)+ out → 一群人“挂”在一起没正事 → 闲逛、一起玩

custom.en: to become, or make someone become, very anxious, upset or excited (informal)
custom.zh: 吓坏、慌了、抓狂
examples: She {freaked out} when she lost her phone.
她手机丢了，整个人都慌了。
custom.tip: 美剧遇到突发状况常喊 “Don't freak out!” = 别慌！

custom.word: I have a reservation under the name Ban.
custom.zh: 我有预订，名字登记的是 Ban。
custom.tip: 到酒店/餐厅报到时直接说，对方就会帮你查预订

custom.zh: 你这话什么意思？（带点质问/不满）
custom.tip: 美剧里不爽/吵架时的经典台词，语气偏冲，朋友间也能半开玩笑用

custom.word: I don't think I can make it.
custom.zh: 我可能去不了 / 赶不上。
custom.tip: make it 在这里 = 赶到/出席，不是“制作它”。约人时超常用

custom.en: existing since birth, especially of a disease or condition
custom.zh: 先天的、天生的（疾病或缺陷）；（口语）天生就……的（congenital liar 天生爱撒谎的人）
examples: She was born with a {congenital} defect.
custom.tip: con-（一起）+ genit（出生，同 gene、generate）＝“和出生一起来的” → 先天的。多用于医学；“天赋”用 natural/innate。

custom.en: physically strong and good at sports; or related to sports
custom.zh: 运动的、体育的；（体格）健壮的、运动能力强的
examples: started to see that I had some {athletic} genes, I maybe picked up some
开始发现自己有一些运动基因，我可能学到了一些
他个子高，运动能力很强。
custom.tip: athlete（运动员）+ -ic（形容词）。重音在第二音节 ath-LET-ic，athlete 只有两个音节，别读成 ath-e-lete。

custom.en: plural of gene: the units in your cells passed down from your parents
custom.zh: 基因（复数）
examples: started to see that I had some athletic {genes}, I maybe picked up some
开始发现自己有一些运动基因，我可能学到了一些
She got her height from her dad's {genes}.
她的身高遗传了她爸的基因。
Good {genes} help, but practice matters more.
好基因有帮助，但练习更重要。
custom.tip: genes 和 jeans（牛仔裤）读音完全一样 /dʒinz/，常被拿来开玩笑：It's in my genes（这是天生的）。gen 词根＝出生，同 generate、congenital。

custom.en: plural of lace: strings used to tie shoes
custom.zh: 鞋带（复数）；（lace）蕾丝、花边；（lace up）系紧鞋带
forms: n. 单数 鞋带；蕾丝
examples: I can feel the {laces} not fixed. I'll turn that into a pump fake.
我能感觉到（球上的）缝线没对好。我会把它变成一个投篮假动作。
custom.tip: shoelaces 常简称 laces；lace 不可数时是“蕾丝”。在原句里球员说投篮时能感觉到球上的“缝线（laces）”没对正，篮球、橄榄球上的缝线也叫 laces。

custom.en: a fake shooting motion in basketball meant to make a defender jump
custom.zh: （篮球）投篮假动作、假投；（v.）做投篮假动作
examples: I can feel the laces not fixed. I'll turn that into a {pump fake}.
我能感觉到（球上的）缝线没对好。我会把它变成一个投篮假动作。
He used a {pump fake} to get a free shot.
他用一个投篮假动作换来了空位出手。
custom.tip: pump（像打气筒一样上下压）+ fake（假的）＝把球往上一“压”假装要投，引防守人起跳。也叫 shot fake。

custom.en: a quick up-and-down movement like a fake shot; also a machine that moves liquid or air
custom.zh: （篮球）假投时把球往上一晃（pump fake）；泵；用泵抽、打气；（pumped）兴奋的
forms: 过去式；adj. 兴奋的、干劲十足的
examples: I can feel the laces not fixed. I'll turn that into a {pump} fake.
我能感觉到（球上的）缝线没对好。我会把它变成一个投篮假动作。
Can you {pump} up my bike tires?
你能帮我给自行车打气吗？
custom.tip: pump 的核心动作是“一下一下压”：打气筒、水泵都是这样。所以篮球里把球往上一压假装投篮＝pump fake；人被“打足了气”＝pumped（兴奋）。

custom.en: a small, quick, sharp movement, especially of the wrist or finger
custom.zh: （手腕等）轻抖、轻弹；（用手指）弹开；快速翻动（flick through）；（口语）电影
examples: Great {flick} flick of the wrist. great flick of the wrist.
手腕那一抖，太漂亮了。手腕一抖，真漂亮。
她啪地打开了电灯开关。
custom.tip: flick 是拟声感很强的词，像“啪”的一下轻弹。投篮常说 the flick of the wrist（手腕一抖）。别和 flicker（闪烁）搞混。

custom.en: the joint between your hand and your arm
custom.zh: 手腕；腕关节
examples: Great flick flick of the {wrist}. great flick of the wrist.
手腕那一抖，太漂亮了。手腕一抖，真漂亮。
She wears a watch on her left {wrist}.
